import { princessKeySettings as settings } from './game-config.js';
import { rollAttackDamage, totalWeaponDamage } from './combat-stats.js';
import { getAllEnemies, getEnemy, damageEnemy } from './world-state.js';
import { getCombatHitbox } from './combat-hitboxes.js';
import { luminousNovaHits, drawLuminousPlasma } from './luminous-nova.js';
import { applySkillControl } from './enemy-control.js';

/** Four independently critting rounds every three frames; Haste never changes this cadence. */
export function createPrincessKeyAttack({random=Math.random}={}) {
  let bullets=[],owner=null,cooldown=0,enabled=true,shots=0;
  function reset(){bullets=[];owner=null;cooldown=0;shots=0;}
  function update(delta,player,aim=0) {
    if(!player.attackSlots?.some(w=>w?.id==='princess-key')){reset();return;}
    if(owner!==player){reset();owner=player;}
    if(!enabled||delta<=0)return;
    let remaining=delta;
    while(remaining>1e-8) {
      if(cooldown<=1e-8) {
        const body=getCombatHitbox(player,false);
        for(let i=0;i<settings.attackCount;i++) {
          const angle=aim+(i/(settings.attackCount-1)-.5)*settings.spreadRadians;
          const dx=Math.cos(angle),dy=Math.sin(angle);
          const offset=1/Math.hypot(dx/body.rx,dy/body.ry)+3+settings.diameter*1.8;
          bullets.push({x:body.x+dx*offset,y:body.y+dy*offset,angle,speed:settings.speed,age:0,hits:new Map(),hitCount:0});shots++;
        }
        cooldown=settings.interval;
      }
      const step=Math.min(remaining,cooldown,1/60),enemies=getAllEnemies();
      for(let i=bullets.length-1;i>=0;i--) {
        const bullet=bullets[i],from={x:bullet.x,y:bullet.y},dt=Math.min(step,settings.duration-bullet.age);
        bullet.age+=dt;bullet.x+=Math.cos(bullet.angle)*settings.speed*dt;bullet.y+=Math.sin(bullet.angle)*settings.speed*dt;
        for(const enemy of enemies) {
          if(bullet.hitCount>=settings.hitLimit)break;
          if(bullet.age-(bullet.hits.get(enemy.id)??-Infinity)<settings.hitCooldown||!luminousNovaHits(enemy,from,bullet,settings.diameter*1.8))continue;
          bullet.hits.set(enemy.id,bullet.age);bullet.hitCount++;
          const hit=rollAttackDamage(player,totalWeaponDamage(player,'princess-key',settings.damageMultiplier,[],{projectileCount:4,hitCooldownFrames:15}),random,{target:enemy});
          const landed=damageEnemy(enemy.id,hit.damage,player,hit.type,{canMiss:true}),living=getEnemy(enemy.id);
          if(landed!==false&&living)applySkillControl(living,Math.cos(bullet.angle)*settings.knockbackSpeed*settings.knockbackSeconds,
            Math.sin(bullet.angle)*settings.knockbackSpeed*settings.knockbackSeconds,settings.knockbackSeconds,settings.knockbackSeconds);
        }
        if(bullet.age>=settings.duration-1e-8||bullet.hitCount>=settings.hitLimit)bullets.splice(i,1);
      }
      remaining-=step;cooldown=Math.max(0,cooldown-step);
    }
  }
  return {ready:Promise.resolve(),reset,update,
    // Reuse Kei's actual plasma renderer: identical pink bloom and continuous tapered tail.
    draw(context,camera){for(const bullet of bullets)drawLuminousPlasma(context,camera,bullet,settings.diameter,settings.duration);},
    setAutoattackEnabled(value){enabled=Boolean(value);if(!enabled)bullets=[];},
    get shotsFired(){return shots;},get projectileCount(){return bullets.length;}};
}
const fs=require('fs'),vm=require('vm'),assert=require('node:assert/strict');
const enemies=new Map(),hits=[],knocks=[];
const c=vm.createContext({getAllEnemies:()=>[...enemies.values()],getEnemy:id=>enemies.get(id),damageEnemy:(id,damage,p,type)=>{hits.push({id,damage,type});return damage},applySkillControl:(...args)=>knocks.push(args)});
for(const name of ['game-config','combat-stats','combat-hitboxes','luminous-nova','princess-key','synergy-recipes','golden-crafter-rules'])vm.runInContext(fs.readFileSync('Development/'+name+'.js','utf8').replace(/^import .*;\r?\n/gm,'').replace(/^export \{.*\} from .*;\r?\n/gm,'').replaceAll('export ',''),c);
vm.runInContext('const settings=princessKeySettings',c);
const run=s=>vm.runInContext(s,c);
run('var player={label:"Plana",x:0,y:0,level:1,combatStats:{hastePercent:500},attackSlots:[{id:"princess-key",level:1,maxLevel:1}]};var attack=createPrincessKeyAttack({random:()=>0})');
run('attack.update(1,player,0)');assert.equal(run('attack.shotsFired'),80);assert(run('attack.projectileCount')<=28);
run('attack.reset();for(let i=0;i<100;i++)attack.update(.01,player,0)');assert.equal(run('attack.shotsFired'),80);
assert.equal(run('rollAttackDamage(player,.5,()=>0).damage'),3);assert.equal(run('rollAttackDamage(player,.5,()=>1).damage'),7);
for(let i=0;i<8;i++)enemies.set(String(i),{id:String(i),type:'mob',x:55+i*5,y:0,spriteSize:20});
run('attack.reset();attack.update(.049,player,0)');assert(hits.length>0);assert(hits.length<=16);assert.equal(knocks[0][3],.05);assert(Math.abs(Math.hypot(knocks[0][1],knocks[0][2])-3)<1e-8);
run('attack.setAutoattackEnabled(false);attack.update(1,player,0)');assert.equal(run('attack.projectileCount'),0);
run('player.attackSlots=[{id:"aris-laser",level:7},{id:"luminous-nova",level:7,maxLevel:7}]');assert.equal(run('goldenCrafterChoices(player).length'),1);
assert(run('applyGoldenCrafterChoice(player,goldenCrafterChoices(player)[0].id).success'));assert.equal(run('player.attackSlots[0].id'),'princess-key');assert.equal(run('player.attackSlots[1]'),null);assert(!run('player.attackSlots[0].exSkill'));
console.log('PASS: live fusion, 80 bullets/s independent of Haste/frame step, 3-7 damage, four-hit limit, small knockback, lifetime and autoattack disable.');

import { damageNumberSettings } from './game-config.js';
export { damageNumberSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { fontMetrics } from './font-metrics.js';

const numbers = [];
const textCache = new Map();
let font;

/** Load one shared bitmap font for all damage numbers. */
export function loadDamageNumberGraphics() {
  font = new Image();
  font.src = '../sprites/font.png';
  return font.decode();
}

/** Format normal hits, yellow critical hits, or red supercrit visuals. */
export function damageNumberStyle(amount, player = false, hitType = 'normal') {
  if (hitType === 'miss') return { text: 'MISS', color: '#ffffff', italic: true };
  const text = String(Math.round(amount * 100) / 100);
  if (player) return { text, color: '#ff5265', italic: false };
  if (hitType === 'supercritical') return { text: `${text}!!!`, color: '#ff5265', italic: true, scale: 1.1 };
  if (hitType === 'critical') return { text: `${text}!`, color: '#ffe15a', italic: true, scale: 1.1 };
  return { text, color: '#ffffff', italic: false };
}

/** Queue a damage popup; supercritical styling does not define its trigger. */
export function showDamageNumber(target, amount, player = false, hitType = 'normal') {
  if ((!(amount > 0) && hitType !== 'miss') || !Number.isFinite(amount) || !Number.isFinite(target.x) || !Number.isFinite(target.y)) return;
  if (numbers.length >= damageNumberSettings.maxCount) numbers.shift();
  numbers.push({ ...damageNumberStyle(amount, player, hitType), elapsed: 0,
    x: target.x, y: target.y - (target.spriteSize || 112) * 0.4,
    drift: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 24 });
}

/** Calculate the upward bounce, downward fall, and gradual end fade. */
export function damageNumberPose(number) {
  const t = number.elapsed;
  const progress = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, t / damageNumberSettings.duration));
  const fade = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (t - damageNumberSettings.fadeStart) /
    (damageNumberSettings.duration - damageNumberSettings.fadeStart)));
  return { x: number.x + number.drift * t,
    y: number.y - 4 * damageNumberSettings.jumpHeight * progress * (1 - progress),
    opacity: 1 - fade * fade };
}

/** Expire popups even when their targets die or leave the viewport. */
export function updateDamageNumbers(delta) {
  for (let i = numbers.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    numbers[i].elapsed += delta;
    if (numbers[i].elapsed >= damageNumberSettings.duration) numbers.splice(i, 1);
  }
}

/** Cache compact tinted bitmap numbers, preserving the font's dark outline. */
function numberGraphic(text, color) {
  const key = `${text}:${color}`;
  if (textCache.has(key)) return textCache.get(key);
  const glyphs = [...text].map(letter => fontMetrics[letter] || fontMetrics['?']);
  const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
  canvas.width = glyphs.reduce((sum, glyph) => sum + glyph.width - 1, 1);
  canvas.height = 20;
  const context = canvas.getContext('2d');
  let x = 0;
  for (const glyph of glyphs) {
    context.drawImage(font, glyph.x, glyph.y, glyph.width, glyph.height,
      x, glyph.offsetY, glyph.width, glyph.height);
    x += glyph.width - 1;
  }
  if (color !== '#ffffff') {
    const mask = document.createElement('canvas');
    mask.width = canvas.width;
    mask.height = canvas.height;
    mask.getContext('2d').drawImage(canvas, 0, 0);
    context.globalCompositeOperation = 'multiply';
    context.fillStyle = color;
    context.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    context.globalCompositeOperation = 'destination-in';
    context.drawImage(mask, 0, 0);
  }
  if (textCache.size >= 128) textCache.delete(textCache.keys().next().value);
  textCache.set(key, canvas);
  return canvas;
}

/** Draw world-anchored numbers above actors, leaving the HUD unaffected. */
export function drawDamageNumbers(context, camera, width, height) {
  if (!font?.naturalWidth) return;
  context.save();
  context.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
  for (const number of numbers) {
    const pose = damageNumberPose(number);
    const x = pose.x - camera.x, y = pose.y - camera.y;
    if (x < -100 || y < -50 || x > width + 100 || y > height + 50) continue;
    const graphic = numberGraphic(number.text, number.color);
    context.save();
    context.translate(x, y);
    context.scale(number.scale ?? 1, number.scale ?? 1);
    if (number.italic) context.transform(1, 0, -0.18, 1, 0, 0);
    context.globalAlpha = pose.opacity;
    context.drawImage(graphic, -graphic.width * 0.625, 0, graphic.width * 1.25, 25);
    context.restore();
  }
  context.restore();
}

export function showDamageNumber(target, amount, player = false, hitType = 'normal', group = null) {
  if ((!(amount > 0) && hitType !== 'miss') || !Number.isFinite(amount) || !Number.isFinite(target.x) || !Number.isFinite(target.y)) return;
  // Only the synergy accumulates rapid hits, independently for each enemy and damage source.
  if(group&&hitType!=='miss') {
    const existing=numbers.find(number=>number.target===target&&number.group===group&&number.sinceHit<=.3);
    if(existing) {
      existing.amount+=amount;existing.sinceHit=0;existing.elapsed=0;
      existing.damageByType[hitType]=(existing.damageByType[hitType]||0)+amount;
      // Style reflects the largest damage contribution, not merely the strongest individual hit.
      // Keep the current style on an exact tie to avoid flickering back and forth.
      for(const type of ['normal','critical','supercritical']) {
        if((existing.damageByType[type]||0)>(existing.damageByType[existing.hitType]||0))existing.hitType=type;
      }
      Object.assign(existing,{scale:1},damageNumberStyle(existing.amount,player,existing.hitType));
      existing.x=target.x;existing.y=target.y-(target.spriteSize||112)*.4;return;
    }
  }
  if (numbers.length >= damageNumberSettings.maxCount) numbers.shift();
  numbers.push({ ...damageNumberStyle(amount, player, hitType), elapsed: 0,
    x: target.x, y: target.y - (target.spriteSize || 112) * 0.4,
    target,group,amount,hitType,damageByType:{[hitType]:amount},sinceHit:0,drift: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 24 });
}

/** Calculate the upward bounce, downward fall, and gradual end fade. */
export function damageNumberPose(number) {
  const t = number.elapsed;
  const progress = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, t / damageNumberSettings.duration));
  const fade = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (t - damageNumberSettings.fadeStart) /
    (damageNumberSettings.duration - damageNumberSettings.fadeStart)));
  return { x: number.x + number.drift * t,
    y: number.y - 4 * damageNumberSettings.jumpHeight * progress * (1 - progress),
    opacity: 1 - fade * fade };
}

/** Expire popups even when their targets die or leave the viewport. */
export function updateDamageNumbers(delta) {
  for (let i = numbers.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    numbers[i].elapsed += delta;
    numbers[i].sinceHit += delta;

import { createLuminousNovaWeapon, getLuminousNova } from './luminous-nova.js';
import { luminousNovaSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { umbrellaUpgradeSettings, arisWeaponSettings, levelUpgradeSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { ensurePlayerStats } from './player-stats.js';
import { createArisWeapon, getArisWeapon } from './aris-weapon.js';
import { getUmbrella } from './weapon-progression.js';

const descriptions = {
  2: 'Increase damage by 30%.',
  3: 'Increase attack area by 20%.',
  4: 'Reduce time between attacks by 10%.',
  5: 'Increase damage by 30%.',
  6: 'Increase attack area by 20%.',
  7: 'Critical hits are guaranteed and deal 3x damage.'
};

/** Offer only the next upgrade for an equipped, implemented weapon. */
function umbrellaChoices(player) {
  ensurePlayerStats(player);
  const weapon = getUmbrella(player);
  if (!weapon) return [];
  const level = weapon.level || 1;
  if (level < umbrellaUpgradeSettings.maxLevel) return [{ id: 'umbrella-level',
    name: `Plana's Umbrella LV ${level + 1}`, weapon, category: 'Weapon', description: descriptions[level + 1] }];
  return [];
}

const arisDescriptions = {
  2: 'Increase beam size by 30%.',
  3: 'Reduce attack cooldown by 0.5 seconds.',
  4: 'Increase damage by 50%.',
  5: 'Reduce attack cooldown by 0.5 seconds.',
  6: 'Increase beam size by 50%.',
  7: 'Fire an additional beam from behind.'
};

const luminousDescriptions={
  2:'Increase damage by 20%.',3:'Fire twice per base attack cycle.',4:'Increase damage by 30%.',
  5:'Fire three times per base attack cycle.',6:'Add knockback on hit.',7:'Fire four times per base attack cycle.'
};

/** Offer acquisition or the next Aris upgrade, plus existing umbrella choices. */
export function rollLevelUpgrades(player) {
  ensurePlayerStats(player);
  const choices = umbrellaChoices(player);
  const weapon = getArisWeapon(player);
  if (!weapon && (player.attackSlots || []).filter(Boolean).length < 6) choices.push({
    id: 'aris-new', name: "Supernova LV 1", weapon: createArisWeapon(), category: 'NEW Weapon',
    description: 'Shoot a powerful piercing laser beam every 3 seconds.'
  });
  else if (weapon && (weapon.level || 1) < arisWeaponSettings.maxLevel) choices.push({
    id: 'aris-level', name: `Supernova LV ${(weapon.level || 1) + 1}`, weapon, category: 'Weapon',
    description: arisDescriptions[(weapon.level || 1) + 1]
  });
  const luminous=getLuminousNova(player);
  if(!luminous&&(player.attackSlots||[]).filter(Boolean).length<6)choices.push({
    id:'luminous-new',name:'Luminous Nova LV 1',weapon:createLuminousNovaWeapon(),category:'NEW Weapon',
    description:'Fire a fast, piercing pink plasma round at a random target.'});
  else if(luminous&&(luminous.level||1)<luminousNovaSettings.maxLevel)choices.push({
    id:'luminous-level',name:`Luminous Nova LV ${(luminous.level||1)+1}`,weapon:luminous,category:'Weapon',
    description:luminousDescriptions[(luminous.level||1)+1]});
  return choices.slice(0, levelUpgradeSettings.choices);
}

/** Advance one weapon level; awakening is available only through a Crafter. */
export function applyLevelUpgrade(player, id) {
  ensurePlayerStats(player);
  if (player.pendingUpgrades <= 0 || !rollLevelUpgrades(player).some(choice => choice.id === id)) return false;
  const weapon = id.startsWith('luminous-')?getLuminousNova(player):id.startsWith('aris-') ? getArisWeapon(player) : getUmbrella(player);
  if (id === 'aris-new'||id==='luminous-new') {
    player.attackSlots ??= [];
    const empty = player.attackSlots.findIndex(item => !item);

import { princessKeySettings as settings } from './game-config.js';
import { rollAttackDamage, totalWeaponDamage } from './combat-stats.js';
import { getAllEnemies, getEnemy, damageEnemy } from './world-state.js';
import { getCombatHitbox } from './combat-hitboxes.js';
import { luminousNovaHits, drawLuminousPlasma } from './luminous-nova.js';
import { applySkillControl } from './enemy-control.js';

/** Stagger four independently critting rounds across each three-frame cycle; ignore Haste. */
export function createPrincessKeyAttack({random=Math.random}={}) {
  let bullets=[],owner=null,cooldown=0,enabled=true,shots=0,gaps=[],shotIndex=0;
  function reset(){bullets=[];owner=null;cooldown=0;shots=0;gaps=[];shotIndex=0;}
  function update(delta,player,aim=0,viewport=null) {
    if(!player.attackSlots?.some(w=>w?.id==='princess-key')){reset();return;}
    if(owner!==player){reset();owner=player;}
    if(!enabled||delta<=0)return;
    let remaining=delta;
    while(remaining>1e-8) {
      if(cooldown<=1e-8) {
        const body=getCombatHitbox(player,false);
        if(shotIndex===0) {
          // Positive randomized gaps sum to exactly one base cycle, preserving total fire rate.
          const weights=Array.from({length:settings.attackCount},()=>.7+random()*.6);
          const total=weights.reduce((sum,value)=>sum+value,0);
          gaps=weights.map(value=>settings.interval*value/total);
        }
        {
          const angle=aim+(random()-.5)*settings.spreadRadians;
          const dx=Math.cos(angle),dy=Math.sin(angle);
          const offset=1/Math.hypot(dx/body.rx,dy/body.ry)+3+settings.diameter*1.8;
          const width=viewport?.width||1280,height=viewport?.height||720;

const imageCache=new Map();
/** Load the original PNGs once; compose crossed icons directly instead of embedding SVG images. */
export function drawSynergyIcon(canvas,item,isCurrent=()=>true) {
  if(item?.id!=='princess-key')return false;
  const layers=[
    {name:'Arisu',angle:-Math.PI/4,color:'#65cfff',crop:[138,12,678,217]},
    {name:'Kei',angle:Math.PI/4,color:'#ff71d5',crop:[130,2,716,226]}
  ];
  Promise.all(layers.map(layer=>{
    const source=`../sprites/attacks/Weapon_Icon_${layer.name}.png`;
    if(!imageCache.has(source)) {
      const image=new Image();image.src=source;
      imageCache.set(source,image.decode().then(()=>image));
    }
    return imageCache.get(source);
  })).then(images=>{
    if(!isCurrent())return;
    const context=canvas.getContext('2d');context.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
    layers.forEach((layer,index)=>{
      const [x,y,width,height]=layer.crop;
      const bound=(width+height)/Math.SQRT2,scale=canvas.width*.86/bound;
      context.save();context.translate(canvas.width/2,canvas.height/2);context.rotate(layer.angle);
      context.shadowColor=layer.color;context.shadowBlur=canvas.width*.035;
      context.drawImage(images[index],x,y,width,height,-width*scale/2,-height*scale/2,width*scale,height*scale);
      context.restore();
    });
  }).catch(()=>{});
  return true;
}

const imageCache=new Map();
/** Load the original PNGs once; compose crossed icons directly instead of embedding SVG images. */
export function drawSynergyIcon(canvas,item,isCurrent=()=>true) {
  if(item?.id!=='princess-key')return false;
  const layers=[
    {name:'Arisu',angle:-Math.PI/4,color:'#65cfff',crop:[138,12,678,217]},
    {name:'Kei',angle:Math.PI/4,color:'#ff71d5',crop:[130,2,716,226]}
  ];
  Promise.all(layers.map(layer=>{
    const source=`../sprites/attacks/Weapon_Icon_${layer.name}.png`;
    if(!imageCache.has(source)) {
      const image=new Image();image.src=source;
      imageCache.set(source,image.decode().then(()=>image));
    }
    return imageCache.get(source);
  })).then(images=>{
    if(!isCurrent())return;
    const context=canvas.getContext('2d');context.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
    layers.forEach((layer,index)=>{
      const [x,y,width,height]=layer.crop;
      const bound=(width+height)/Math.SQRT2,scale=canvas.width*.86/bound;
      context.save();context.translate(canvas.width/2,canvas.height/2);context.rotate(layer.angle);
      context.shadowColor=layer.color;context.shadowBlur=canvas.width*.035;
      context.drawImage(images[index],x,y,width,height,-width*scale/2,-height*scale/2,width*scale,height*scale);
      context.restore();
    });
  }).catch(()=>{});
  return true;

/** Advance one weapon level; awakening is available only through a Crafter. */
export function applyLevelUpgrade(player, id) {
  ensurePlayerStats(player);
  if (player.pendingUpgrades <= 0 || !rollLevelUpgrades(player).some(choice => choice.id === id)) return false;
  const weapon = id.startsWith('luminous-')?getLuminousNova(player):id.startsWith('aris-') ? getArisWeapon(player) : getUmbrella(player);
  if (id === 'aris-new'||id==='luminous-new') {
    player.attackSlots ??= [];
    const empty = player.attackSlots.findIndex(item => !item);
    const acquired=id==='luminous-new'?createLuminousNovaWeapon():createArisWeapon();
    if (empty >= 0) player.attackSlots[empty] = acquired;
    else player.attackSlots.push(acquired);
  } else if (id === 'aris-level') weapon.level = Math.min(arisWeaponSettings.maxLevel, (weapon.level || 1) + 1);
  else if(id==='luminous-level')weapon.level=Math.min(luminousNovaSettings.maxLevel,(weapon.level||1)+1);
  else if (id === 'umbrella-level') weapon.level = Math.min(umbrellaUpgradeSettings.maxLevel, (weapon.level || 1) + 1);
  else return false;
  player.pendingUpgrades--;
  return true;
}
/** A valid attempt consumes one Crafter even when a paid enhancement fails. */
export function applyCrafterChoice(player,id,random=Math.random) {
  const choice=crafterChoices(player).find(c=>c.id===id);
  if(!choice||choice.disabled)return {consumed:false,success:false,message:'That upgrade is unavailable.'};
  const action=id.split(':').at(-1),target=choice.target;
  if(action==='level') {target.level=(target.level||1)+1;return {consumed:true,success:true,message:`${choice.name} upgraded to LV ${target.level}.`};}
  if(action==='awaken') {
    if(!spendSecretTechNotes(umbrellaUpgradeSettings.awakeningNoteCost))return {consumed:false,success:false};
    target.awakened=true;return {consumed:true,success:true,message:`${choice.name} awakened!`};
  }
  if(!spendCredits(choice.cost))return {consumed:false,success:false};
  const success=random()<choice.chance;
  if(success)target.enhancementRank=choice.rank;
  return {consumed:true,success,message:success?`${choice.name} enhanced to +${choice.rank}!`:`Enhancement failed. ${choice.cost} Credits and the Crafter were consumed.`};
}

/** Record the first time a weapon reaches MAX, independent of inventory position. */
export function recordWeaponMax(player,weapon) {
  if(!weapon||weapon.isSynergy||weapon.level<(weapon.maxLevel||7)||weapon.maxedOrder!==undefined)return;
  player.weaponMaxSequence=Math.max(player.weaponMaxSequence||0,...(player.attackSlots||[]).map(w=>w?.maxedOrder||0))+1;
  weapon.maxedOrder=player.weaponMaxSequence;
}

import { combatBalance } from './game-config.js';
import { normalSpriteSize, spriteDisplayPadding } from './scene-metrics.js';

// EDIT half-width, half-height and center offset as fractions of display size.
// Ellipses exclude transparent corners while covering more of the visible body.
export const combatHitboxes = {
  plana: { rx: 0.27, ry: 0.38, y: 0.03, playerOffsetY: 6, playerRadiusScale: 0.72 }, // Pixels downward for the controlled player.
  arona: { rx: 0.25, ry: 0.39, y: 0.03 },
  // Small foot-level ellipse: tune rx/ry for size; feet keeps it at the sprite baseline.
  midori: { rx: 0.13, ry: 0.075, radiusSize: normalSpriteSize, feet: true },
  yuuka: { rx: 0.25, ry: 0.42, y: 0.02 },
  mob: { rx: 0.28, ry: 0.28, y: 0.04, eliteOffsetY: 6, normalOffsetY: 6 }, // Circular Mob collider; elite variants scale the same profile.
  iroha: { rx: 0.44, ry: 0.29, y: 0.06 },
  shiroko: { rx: 0.30, ry: 0.30, y: 0.05 } // Center on the visible body below the halo.
};

/** Return a stable body ellipse, scaling automatically for elite/boss sizes. */
export function getCombatHitbox(character, enemy = Boolean(character.id)) {
  const name = (character.type || character.label || 'mob').toLowerCase();
  const key = Object.keys(combatHitboxes).find(type => name.includes(type)) || 'mob';
  const profile = character.combatHitbox || combatHitboxes[key];
  const size = character.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize;
  const hitboxScale = enemy ? combatBalance.enemyHitboxScale : 1;
  const radiusSize = profile.radiusSize || size;
  const rx = radiusSize * profile.rx * hitboxScale * (enemy ? 1 : profile.playerRadiusScale || 1);
  // Compress player height to the existing half-width, producing a centered circle.
  const ry = enemy ? radiusSize * profile.ry * hitboxScale : rx;
  // Foot-anchored profiles retain their small dimensions when the artwork grows.
  const offsetY = !enemy ? (profile.playerOffsetY || 0) : profile.feet ? size / 2 - spriteDisplayPadding - ry : size * profile.y;
  const eliteOffsetY = enemy ? (character.elite ? profile.eliteOffsetY || 0 : profile.normalOffsetY || 0) : 0;
  return { x: character.x, y: character.y + offsetY + eliteOffsetY, rx, ry };
}

/** Test a blade segment against an ellipse in normalized body coordinates. */
export function segmentHitsBody(body, x1, y1, x2, y2) {
  const x = (x1 - body.x) / body.rx, y = (y1 - body.y) / body.ry;
  const dx = (x2 - x1) / body.rx, dy = (y2 - y1) / body.ry;
  const length = dx * dx + dy * dy;
  const t = length ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1, -(x * dx + y * dy) / length)) : 0;
  return (x + dx * t) ** 2 + (y + dy * t) ** 2 <= 1;
}

/** Ease into a swift central slash, then decelerate at the end of a 180ÃƒÆ’Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â° sweep. */
export function umbrellaSwingAngle(aim, elapsed, duration = umbrellaSettings.duration) {
  const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, elapsed / duration));
  const eased = t < 0.5 ? 4 * t ** 3 : 1 - (-2 * t + 2) ** 3 / 2;
  const arc = umbrellaSettings.arcDegrees * Math.PI / 180;
  return aim - arc / 2 + eased * arc;
}

/** Test the swept blade sector so fast swings cannot skip enemies between frames. */
export function umbrellaHits(player, enemy, fromAngle, toAngle, areaScale = 1) {
  areaScale *= umbrellaSettings.sizeScale;
  const body = getCombatHitbox(enemy, true);
  const dx = body.x - player.x, dy = body.y - player.y;
  const distance = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
  const radius = Math.max(body.rx, body.ry);
  if (distance > umbrellaSettings.reach * areaScale + radius) return false;
  if (distance + radius < umbrellaSettings.damageInnerRadius * areaScale) return false;
  // Subdivide the swept sector into blade segments at most 2 degrees apart.
  const samples = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(Math.abs(toAngle - fromAngle) / (Math.PI / 90)));
  for (let i = 0; i <= samples; i++) {
    const angle = fromAngle + (toAngle - fromAngle) * i / samples;
    const x = Math.cos(angle), y = Math.sin(angle);
    if (segmentHitsBody(body,
      player.x + x * umbrellaSettings.damageInnerRadius * areaScale, player.y + y * umbrellaSettings.damageInnerRadius * areaScale,
      player.x + x * umbrellaSettings.reach * areaScale, player.y + y * umbrellaSettings.reach * areaScale)) return true;
  }
  return false;
}

/** Roll the supplied27-33base damage range, then weapon levels and player ATK/crit. */
export function rollArisDamage(player, random = Math.random, target, damageMod = 1) {
  const s = arisWeaponSettings;
  return rollAttackDamage(player, totalWeaponDamage(player, 'aris-laser', s.damageMultiplier,
    [(arisLevelStats(player).damage - 1) * 100],
    { projectileCount: arisLevelStats(player).beams, hitCooldownFrames: s.hitCooldown * 60 }), random, { target, damageMod });
}

/** Invisible piercing capsule starts at the player, bridging the decorative muzzle gap. */
export function arisBeamHits(enemy, origin, angle, width, length = arisWeaponSettings.beamLength) {
  const body = getEnemyHurtbox(enemy);
  return segmentHitsBody({ ...body, rx: body.rx + width / 2, ry: body.ry + width / 2 },
    origin.x, origin.y, origin.x + Math.cos(angle) * length, origin.y + Math.sin(angle) * length);
}

import { midoriDodges } from './midori.js';

export { enemyPopulationSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { isAdminSeed } from './run-seed.js';
// Persistent-in-session enemy state is separate from disposable background tiles.
// Future enemy spawning should register world coordinates here, never screen X/Y.
import { dropEnemyExp, dropEnemyLoot, dropYuukaCredits } from './exp-drops.js';

import { showDamageNumber } from './damage-numbers.js';
import { normalSpriteSize } from './scene-metrics.js';



/** Boss identity is explicit, never inferred from an elite's enlarged sprite. */
export function isBossEnemy(enemy) {
  if(enemy.boss === false) return false;
  return enemy.boss === true || enemy.type === 'iroha' || enemy.type === 'shiroko';
}

/** Render special enemies above normal actors, while bosses always own the final layer. */
export function enemyRenderLayer(enemy) {
  if (isBossEnemy(enemy)) return 'boss';
  return enemy.special === true || enemy.type === 'yuuka' ? 'special' : 'normal';
}

/** Measure distance from sprite edges to the gameplay viewport rectangle. */
export function enemyViewportDistance(enemy, camera, width, height) {
  const radius = (enemy.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) / 2;
  const dx = Math.max(camera.x - (enemy.x + radius), enemy.x - radius - camera.x - width, 0);
  const dy = Math.max(camera.y - (enemy.y + radius), enemy.y - radius - camera.y - height, 0);
  return Math.hypot(dx, dy);
}

const enemies = new Map();
const spawnListeners = new Set();
const defeatListeners = new Set();
const damageListeners = new Set();
let killCount = 0;

export const enemyTestConfig = { oneHp: isAdminSeed };
const savedEnemyHealth = new WeakMap();

/** Toggle 1-HP enemies for this session, including elites, bosses and future spawns. */
export function setOneHpEnemies(enabled) {
  enemyTestConfig.oneHp = Boolean(enabled);
  for (const enemy of enemies.values()) applyEnemyHealthTest(enemy);
}

/** Preserve normal health so disabling the test restores surviving enemies. */
function applyEnemyHealthTest(enemy) {
  if (enemyTestConfig.oneHp) {
    if (!savedEnemyHealth.has(enemy)) savedEnemyHealth.set(enemy, { hp: enemy.hp, maxHp: enemy.maxHp });
    enemy.hp = enemy.maxHp = 1;
  } else if (savedEnemyHealth.has(enemy)) {
    Object.assign(enemy, savedEnemyHealth.get(enemy));
    savedEnemyHealth.delete(enemy);
  }
}

/** Observe real spawns/defeats; cleanup removals never emit these events. */
export function onEnemySpawn(listener) {
  spawnListeners.add(listener);
  return () => spawnListeners.delete(listener);
}

const cache=new WeakMap();
/** Cache a compact alpha silhouette per animation crop; transparent sprite-sheet padding cannot take hits. */
export function spriteDamageMask(image,crop) {
  let frames=cache.get(image);if(!frames){frames=new Map();cache.set(image,frames);}
  const key=[crop.x,crop.y,crop.width,crop.height].join(':');
  if(frames.has(key))return frames.get(key);
  const canvas=document.createElement('canvas');canvas.width=canvas.height=32;
  const context=canvas.getContext('2d',{willReadFrequently:true});
  context.drawImage(image,crop.x,crop.y,crop.width,crop.height,0,0,32,32);
  const pixels=context.getImageData(0,0,32,32).data,runs=[];
  for(let y=0;y<32;y++)for(let x=0;x<32;) {
    if(pixels[(y*32+x)*4+3]<32){x++;continue;}

  }
  frames.set(key,runs);return runs;
}
/** Damage-receiving sprite bounds are separate from the small contact-damage ellipse. */
export function getEnemyHurtbox(character) {
  const size=character.spriteSize||normalSpriteSize;
  const bounds=character.spriteHurtbox||{offsetX:0,offsetY:0,width:size-spriteDisplayPadding*2,height:size-spriteDisplayPadding*2};
  return {x:character.x+bounds.offsetX,y:character.y+bounds.offsetY,
    rx:Math.max(1,bounds.width/2),ry:Math.max(1,bounds.height/2),shape:'rectangle',
    mask:bounds.mask,mirrored:bounds.mirrored,maskWidth:bounds.width,maskHeight:bounds.height};
}

/** Return a source rectangle using the sheet's uneven per-column row boundaries. */
function getFrameRectangle(character, frame) {
  const facing = character.horizontalFacingOnly ? character.facing : character.direction;
  const row = character.attack
    ? character.attacks[character.attack.name].rows[character.attack.facing]
    : !character.moving && character.idleRows?.[facing] !== undefined
    ? character.idleRows[facing]
    : character.rows[facing];
  // Attack artwork can exceed the grid cell. Custom rectangles keep the tank's
  // anchor fixed even when a muzzle flash needs a wider crop.
  const custom = character.layout.frames?.[row]?.[frame];
  if (custom) return custom;
  const { columnEdges, rowEdges } = character.layout;
  return {
    x: columnEdges[frame],
    y: rowEdges[frame][row],
    width: columnEdges[frame + 1] - columnEdges[frame],
    height: rowEdges[frame][row + 1] - rowEdges[frame][row],
    anchorX: character.layout.anchorX?.[row]?.[frame],
    footY: character.layout.footY?.[frame]?.[row] ?? rowEdges[frame][row + 1]
  };
}

  return boxes.every(box => x+radius <= box.left || x-radius >= box.right ||

}

const cache=new WeakMap();
/** Fit one ellipse with at least 90% opaque-pixel coverage and the least empty area.
 * Diagnostics expose whether the requested <=5% empty-space target is geometrically possible.
 */
export function fitSpriteOval(runs) {
  const points=[];
  for(const run of runs)for(let i=0;i<Math.round(run.width*32);i++)
    points.push({x:run.x-run.width/2+(i+.5)/32,y:run.y});
  if(!points.length)return null;
  const xs=points.map(p=>p.x),ys=points.map(p=>p.y);
  const left=Math.min(...xs)-1/64,right=Math.max(...xs)+1/64,top=Math.min(...ys)-1/64,bottom=Math.max(...ys)+1/64;
  const width=right-left,height=bottom-top;
  const center={x:(left+right)/2,y:(top+bottom)/2};
  const centroid={x:xs.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/points.length,y:ys.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/points.length};
  let best=null;
  for(const c of [center,centroid,{x:center.x,y:centroid.y}])
    for(let a=0;a<=10;a++)for(let b=0;b<=10;b++) {
      const rx=width*(.4+a*.05),ry=height*(.4+b*.05);
      let inside=0;
      for(const p of points)if(((p.x-c.x)/rx)**2+((p.y-c.y)/ry)**2<=1)inside++;
      const coverage=inside/points.length;
      if(coverage<.9)continue;
      const emptyFraction=Math.max(0,1-inside/(1024*Math.PI*rx*ry));
      if(!best||emptyFraction<best.emptyFraction)best={...c,rx,ry,coverage,emptyFraction,meetsTargets:emptyFraction<=.05};
    }
  return best;
}
/** Cache a compact alpha silhouette per animation crop; transparent sprite-sheet padding cannot take hits. */
export function spriteDamageMask(image,crop) {
  let frames=cache.get(image);if(!frames){frames=new Map();cache.set(image,frames);}
  const key=[crop.x,crop.y,crop.width,crop.height].join(':');
  if(frames.has(key))return frames.get(key);
  const canvas=document.createElement('canvas');canvas.width=canvas.height=32;
  const context=canvas.getContext('2d',{willReadFrequently:true});
  context.drawImage(image,crop.x,crop.y,crop.width,crop.height,0,0,32,32);
  const pixels=context.getImageData(0,0,32,32).data,runs=[];
  for(let y=0;y<32;y++)for(let x=0;x<32;) {
    if(pixels[(y*32+x)*4+3]<32){x++;continue;}
    const start=x;while(x<32&&pixels[(y*32+x)*4+3]>=32)x++;
    runs.push({x:(start+x)/64,y:(y+.5)/32,width:(x-start)/32,height:1/32});
  }
  runs.ellipse=fitSpriteOval(runs);
  frames.set(key,runs);return runs;
}

import { createBitmapText, glyphRectangle } from './bitmap-font.js';
import { getLootTotals } from './exp-drops.js';
import { getKillCount } from './world-state.js';
import { applyEnhancedWeaponGlow } from './weapon-glow.js';
import { drawSynergyIcon } from './synergy-icon.js';

/** Reserve only visible caption ink, accounting for the slot art's top padding. */
export function levelCaptionSpacing(slotWidth, text) {
  const glyphs = [...text].filter(letter => letter !== ' ').map(glyphRectangle);
  const textWidth = [...text].reduce((sum, letter) => sum +
    (letter === ' ' ? 3 : glyphRectangle(letter).width - 1), 1);
  const inkBottom = Math.max(...glyphs.map(glyph => glyph.offsetY + glyph.height));
  const nextBoxInset = slotWidth * (1 - 237 / 255) / 2;
  return Math.max(0, slotWidth * 0.9 * inkBottom / textWidth - 6 - nextBoxInset);
}

/** Keep the equipment frame 2px below the lowest visible attack-level outline. */
function updateCaptionRowSpacing(container, entries) {
  let spacing = 0;
  for (const entry of entries) {
    if (!entry.caption.hidden) spacing = Math.max(spacing,
      levelCaptionSpacing(entry.slot.getBoundingClientRect().width, entry.captionText));
  }
  container.style.setProperty('--level-space', `${spacing}px`);
}

## My request:
I have added 'Files' aka boxes.



Mechanics\
Gacha Files contain either one or three products, which can be new weapons or items or upgrades to these, as well as a random amount of Credits. There is a 5% chance for a Gacha Files to be a super box, containing one super item (this will be signified by a special animation), and a 9% chance to be a triple box containing three items.\
\
Players can choose whether to accept the item(s) inside, or drop them. There is also a chance that Holozon Boxes will drop 100 Credits instead of an item. This chance increases the more fully upgraded weapons and items the player has.



Reward generation\
The reward is generated via the following procedure.\
\
Normal File:\
There is a 7/10 chance for the reward to be a weapon and 3/10 chance for an item.\
If the player cannot be offered a weapon (no available slots and fully leveled), the reward will be replaced by an item.\
If the player cannot be offered an item, the game will attempt to roll again for a weapon, up to 5 times.\
If the previous attempt fails (or both options are simply unavailable), the player will be rewarded additional Credits instead.\
Once the type is determined, the reward will be chosen from a list of available options, in the same way as during a level up. The only difference is that there is only a 1/10 chance that a new item/weapon is offered.



**Super File:**

The game will list all super items available to the player and select one at random. Each item has equal chance to be selected.

If no super items can be offered to the player, the box will be treated as a normal box.

**Triple File:**

The triple boxes function almost identically to a normal box. However, the second box cannot offer new equipment if the player only has one inventory slot available for that type, and the third cannot offer new equipment unless more than two slots are available in that category.

For example, if you have 5 items and 4 weapons in your inventory prior to opening the box, the second box can offer either a new or owned weapon, but only equipped items, and the third can only reward an already owned weapon or item.



Credits\
The amount of Credits rewarded without any coin multipliers ranges from 72 to 130 for normal boxes, from 126 to 252 for triple boxes and from 158 to 332 for super boxes. The amount of Credits rewarded is affected by the Credits Gain Up shop upgrade and the stage coin multiplier, but not by [Item uet yet to add].\
\
Overall, the amount of Credits rewarded and how it is affected by coin multipliers is determined by the following formula:

`boxCoinGain = floor( floor(a/(3 + irandom(2))) * (1 + moneyUpBonus/100%) * stageMultiplier * (1 + b * (20 + irandom(10))/100 * (1 + moneyUpBonus/100%) * stageMultiplier) ) `



where *moneyoneyUpBonus* is the percentage bonus from Credit Gain Up , *stageMultiplier* the stage's coin multiplier and *a* and *b* are variables depending on the type of the box:

|        |  a  |  b  |
| :----: | :-: | :-: |
| Normal | 301 |  1  |
| Triple | 399 |  3  |
|  Super | 399 |  5  |



The animation consisists of the file in the cneter, when opened, the coins up top will count up while credits around the page will fly to the top of the screen

export function createCrafterSystem({getPlayer,canvas,onOpen=()=>{},onChange=()=>{},onResult=()=>{},golden=false,getMinuteTimer=()=>0}) {
  const drops=new Map();let nextId=0,active=null,ignoreUntilLeave=null;
  const toast=document.createElement('div');toast.className='crafter-toast';toast.setAttribute('role','status');toast.hidden=true;canvas.parentElement.append(toast);let toastTimer;
  const icon=new Image();icon.src=crafterSettings.icon.source;
  const ready=icon.decode();
  /** Close without consuming; require leaving its pickup radius before reopening. */
  function close() {ignoreUntilLeave=active;active=null;menu.close();canvas.focus({preventScroll:true});}
  const menu=createCrafterMenu({canvas,getPlayer,golden,onCancel:close,onAction:id=>{
    if(active===null||!drops.has(active))return;
    const result=golden?applyGoldenCrafterChoice(getPlayer(),id):applyCrafterChoice(getPlayer(),id);
    if(!result.consumed){menu.refresh();return;}
    drops.delete(active);close();onChange();
    // Successful fusion is shown directly by the new inventory weapon, without an alert.
    if(golden&&result.success)return;
    onResult(result.message);
    toast.textContent=result.message;toast.hidden=false;clearTimeout(toastTimer);toastTimer=setTimeout(()=>{toast.hidden=true},4000);
  }});
  function open(drop) {active=drop.id;onOpen();menu.open();}
  /** Place on safe ground, respecting the twenty-Crafter limit even for test drops. */
  function spawn(x,y) {
    if(drops.size>=(golden?crafterSettings.goldenMaxGround:crafterSettings.maxGround))return false;
    const point=safeDropLanding(x,y);if(!point)return false;
    const drop={id:++nextId,...point};drops.set(drop.id,drop);return drop;
  }
  function roll(enemy,random=Math.random) {
    if(drops.size>=(golden?crafterSettings.goldenMaxGround:crafterSettings.maxGround))return false;
    // Credit Card can later supply this multiplier without changing the base drop chance.
    if(golden&&!goldenCrafterChoices(getPlayer()).length)return false;
    const chance=golden?goldenCrafterChance(getMinuteTimer()):Math.min(1,crafterSettings.dropChance*Math.max(0,getPlayer().crafterDropMultiplier??1));
    return random()<chance?spawn(enemy.x,enemy.y):false;
  }
  /** Walk onto a Crafter to open it; cancellation does not destroy the ground object. */
  function update(player,previous) {
    if(active!==null)return;
    for(const drop of drops.values()) {
      if(ignoreUntilLeave===drop.id) {
        if(!crafterTouchesPlayer(drop,player,player,crafterSettings.reentryPadding))ignoreUntilLeave=null;
        continue; // Leaving after Cancel must not immediately reactivate via the swept path.
      }
      if(crafterTouchesPlayer(drop,player,previous||player)){open(drop);break;}
    }
  }

  /** Draw the source-sheet icon and a large white directional triangle, clamped at screen edges. */
  function draw(context,camera,width,height) {
    if(!icon.naturalWidth)return;
    const crop=crafterSettings.icon;
    for(const drop of drops.values()) {
      const x=drop.x-camera.x,y=drop.y-camera.y;
      if(x>-40&&x<width+40&&y>-60&&y<height+crafterSettings.glow.pillarHeight)drawCrafterGlow(context,x,y,golden);
      const bounds=crafterSpriteBounds(drop);
      if(x>-40&&x<width+40&&y>-60&&y<height+40) {
        context.save();if(golden)context.filter='sepia(1) saturate(4)';
        context.drawImage(icon,crop.x,crop.y,crop.width,crop.height,
          bounds.left-camera.x,bounds.top-camera.y,bounds.right-bounds.left,bounds.bottom-bounds.top);context.restore();
      }
      const offscreen=x<20||x>width-20||y<20||y>height-20;
      let ax=x,ay=Math.max(28,y-crafterSettings.glow.pillarHeight-18),angle=Math.PI/2;
      if(offscreen) {
        const dx=x-width/2,dy=y-height/2;
        const scale=Math.min((width/2-30)/Math.max(.001,Math.abs(dx)),(height/2-30)/Math.max(.001,Math.abs(dy)));
        ax=width/2+dx*scale;ay=height/2+dy*scale;angle=Math.atan2(dy,dx);
      }

      context.beginPath();context.moveTo(22,0);context.lineTo(-14,-17);context.lineTo(-14,17);context.closePath();context.fill();context.stroke();context.restore();

import { eliteExpTotalFormula } from './game-config.js';

export { lootLandingRadius, pickupMagnet, creditDropChance, secretNoteDropChance, eliteLoot, dropScatter, eliteExpRewards, bossExpRewards } from './game-config.js';
import { yuukaSettings } from './yuuka.js';
import { addPlayerExp, experienceForLevel } from './player-stats.js';
import { statMultiplier, ensureCombatStats } from './combat-stats.js';

// World-space records survive camera scrolling and map switches for this session.
const drops = new Map();
let nextId = 0;
let getActivePlayer = () => ({ level: 1 });
let isLandingClear = () => true;
 // Clearance for rotated report/credit/note artwork.
const iconWidth = pickupSettings.iconWidth; // EDIT drop size: 25% larger; roughly 30% of Plana's visible height.
const pickupRadius = pickupSettings.walkOverRadius; // EDIT walk-over collection radius in world pixels.
 // Pixels/secÃƒâ€šÃ‚Â² and pixels/sec.
 // EDIT occasional credit chance (~1.11%).
 // 0.1% per defeated enemy.
// EDIT elite bonus rewards independently of normal-enemy drop rates.

const lootTotals = { credits: 0, secretTechNotes: 0 }; // Shared across avatar swaps.


/** Find walkable ground near the intended landing, even if an enemy died inside an obstacle. */
export function safeDropLanding(x, y) {
  if (isLandingClear(x, y, lootLandingRadius)) return { x, y };
  for (let radius = 24; radius <= 2048; radius += 24) {
    const samples = Math.min(64, Math.ceil(radius / 12) * 8);
    for (let index = 0; index < samples; index++) {
      const angle = index / samples * Math.PI * 2;
      const px = x + Math.cos(angle) * radius, py = y + Math.sin(angle) * radius;
      if (isLandingClear(px, py, lootLandingRadius)) return { x: px, y: py };
    }
  }
  return null;
}

/** Redirect a scatter to safe ground; retain unplaceable loot for a later retry. */
export function constrainDropLanding(drop) {
  const flight = drop.scatter;
  const landing = safeDropLanding(flight.x + flight.dx, flight.y + flight.dy);
  drop.pendingLanding = !landing;
  if (landing) {
    flight.dx = landing.x - flight.x;
    flight.dy = landing.y - flight.y;
  }
}

/** Launch loot toward a random nearby landing spot with a small airborne hop. */
export function launchDrop(drop, random = Math.random) {
  const angle = random() * Math.PI * 2;
  const distance = dropScatter.minDistance + random() * (dropScatter.maxDistance - dropScatter.minDistance);
  drop.scatter = { elapsed: 0, x: drop.x, y: drop.y,
    dx: Math.cos(angle) * distance, dy: Math.sin(angle) * distance,
    rotation: drop.rotation, spin: (random() - 0.5) * Math.PI };
  constrainDropLanding(drop);
  return drop;
}

/** Animate the outward toss before enabling pickup attraction or collection. */
export function updateDropScatter(drop, delta) {
  if (!drop.scatter) return false;
  if (drop.pendingLanding) {
    drop.landingRetry = (drop.landingRetry || 0) - delta;
    if (drop.landingRetry <= 0) { constrainDropLanding(drop); drop.landingRetry = 0.5; }
    if (drop.pendingLanding) return true;
  }
  const flight = drop.scatter;
  flight.elapsed += Math.max(0, delta);
  const t = Math.min(1, flight.elapsed / dropScatter.duration);
  const progress = 1 - (1 - t) ** 2;
  drop.x = flight.x + flight.dx * progress;
  drop.y = flight.y + flight.dy * progress;
  drop.lift = 4 * dropScatter.hopHeight * t * (1 - t);
  drop.rotation = flight.rotation + flight.spin * progress;
  if (t === 1) { delete drop.scatter; drop.lift = 0; }
  return true;
}

/** Read a snapshot of collected session inventory, including spendable awakening notes. */
export function getLootTotals() {
  return { ...lootTotals };
}

/** Spend run Credits atomically; rejected purchases never modify the balance. */
export function spendCredits(amount) {
  if(!Number.isInteger(amount)||amount<0||lootTotals.credits<amount)return false;
  lootTotals.credits-=amount;return true;
}

/** Spend collected notes atomically; failed awakenings never consume currency. */
export function spendSecretTechNotes(amount) {
  if (!Number.isInteger(amount) || amount <= 0 || lootTotals.secretTechNotes < amount) return false;
  lootTotals.secretTechNotes -= amount;
  return true;
}

import { rollLevelUpgrades } from './level-upgrades.js';
import { recordWeaponMax } from './weapon-max-order.js';

// Add actual super items here when their effects are defined. Empty pools fall back to normal Files.
export const superFileItems=[];
export const fileSettings={superChance:.05,tripleChance:.09,newChance:.1,weaponChance:.7,
  dropChance:0,bossGuaranteed:false,icon:null,maxGround:20};

/** Inclusive integer rolls and the supplied nested-floor Credits formula. */
export function fileCredits(type,random=Math.random,moneyUpBonus=0,stageMultiplier=1) {
  const [a,b]=type==='super'?[399,5]:type==='triple'?[399,3]:[301,1];
  const integer=max=>Math.min(max,Math.floor(random()*(max+1)));
  const multiplier=(1+moneyUpBonus/100)*stageMultiplier;
  return Math.floor(Math.floor(a/(3+integer(2)))*multiplier*(1+b*(20+integer(10))/100*multiplier));
}

/** Apply one accepted product without spending level-up choices; dropping never applies it. */
export function acceptFileProduct(player,product) {
  const slots=product.kind==='item'?(player.equipmentSlots??=[]):(player.attackSlots??=[]);
  const owned=slots.find(item=>item?.id===product.weapon.id);
  if(owned) {
    if(owned.isSynergy)return false;
    const max=owned.maxLevel||7;if((owned.level||1)>=max)return false;
    owned.level=(owned.level||1)+1;if(product.kind!=='item')recordWeaponMax(player,owned);return true;
  }
  const index=slots.findIndex(item=>!item);
  if(index<0&&slots.filter(Boolean).length>=6)return false;
  const item={...product.weapon};if(index>=0)slots[index]=item;else slots.push(item);return true;
}

/** Generate products using a shadow inventory so triple rewards cannot overfill or overlevel it. */
export function rollFileRewards(player,{random=Math.random,forceType,getOptions=rollLevelUpgrades,superItems=superFileItems}={}) {
  const roll=random();let type=forceType||(roll<.05?'super':roll<.14?'triple':'normal');
  const supers=superItems.filter(item=>!player.equipmentSlots?.some(owned=>owned?.id===item.id)&&
    (player.equipmentSlots||[]).filter(Boolean).length<6);
  if(type==='super'&&!supers.length)type='normal';
  const result={type,products:[],credits:fileCredits(type,random,player.moneyUpBonus||0,player.stageCoinMultiplier??1)};
  if(type==='super') {
    const item=supers[Math.min(supers.length-1,Math.floor(random()*supers.length))];
    result.products.push({kind:'item',weapon:{...item,level:1},name:item.name,super:true});return result;
  }
  const shadow={...player,attackSlots:(player.attackSlots||[]).map(w=>w?{...w}:null),equipmentSlots:(player.equipmentSlots||[]).map(w=>w?{...w}:null)};
  const free={weapon:6-shadow.attackSlots.filter(Boolean).length,item:6-shadow.equipmentSlots.filter(Boolean).length};
  for(let index=0;index<(type==='triple'?3:1);index++) {
    const maxed=[...shadow.attackSlots,...shadow.equipmentSlots].filter(w=>w&&(w.isSynergy||(w.level||1)>=(w.maxLevel||7))).length;
    // Editable saturation behavior: each MAX slot adds 5 percentage points toward the 100-Credit substitution.
    if(random()<Math.min(.6,maxed*.05)){result.credits+=100;continue;}
    const options=getOptions(shadow).filter(choice=>choice.weapon&&!choice.weapon.isSynergy);
    let selected=null;
    for(let attempt=0;attempt<5&&!selected;attempt++) {
      let kind=random()<.7?'weapon':'item';
      const allowNew=random()<.1;
      const pool=k=>options.filter(option=>{
        const category=/item|equipment/i.test(option.category||'')?'item':'weapon';
        const owned=(k==='item'?shadow.equipmentSlots:shadow.attackSlots).some(w=>w?.id===option.weapon.id);
        return category===k&&(owned||(allowNew&&free[k]>index));
      });
      let candidates=pool(kind);if(!candidates.length&&kind==='weapon'){kind='item';candidates=pool(kind);}
      if(candidates.length){const choice=candidates[Math.min(candidates.length-1,Math.floor(random()*candidates.length))];selected={...choice,kind};}
    }
    if(selected&&acceptFileProduct(shadow,selected))result.products.push(selected);else result.credits+=100;
  }
  return result;
}

import { fileSettings,rollFileRewards,acceptFileProduct } from './gacha-file-rules.js';

import { getCombatHitbox,segmentHitsBody } from './combat-hitboxes.js';
import { createBitmapText } from './bitmap-font.js';

/** Boss delivery packages, a paused opening sequence, and individually accepted/dropped products. */
export function createGachaFiles({canvas,getPlayer,onOpen=()=>{},onChange=()=>{}}) {
  const drops=new Map();let nextId=0,active=false,animation=0;
  const image=new Image();image.src=fileSettings.icon;const ready=image.decode();
  const dialog=document.createElement('dialog');dialog.className='gacha-file-menu';dialog.setAttribute('aria-label','Gacha File');document.body.append(dialog);
  function label(element,value){element.setAttribute('aria-label',value);const graphic=document.createElement('canvas');element.append(graphic);createBitmapText(graphic,{variant:'font2',scale:1.2}).setText(value);}
  function align(){const r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();Object.assign(dialog.style,{left:`${r.left}px`,top:`${r.top}px`,width:`${r.width}px`,height:`${r.height}px`});}
  window.addEventListener('resize',()=>{if(active)align();});
  function close(){cancelAnimationFrame(animation);active=false;dialog.close();canvas.focus();onChange();}
  function open(drop) {
    if(active)return;active=true;drops.delete(drop.id);onOpen();align();dialog.replaceChildren();
    const reward=rollFileRewards(getPlayer(),{forceType:drop.forceType});dialog.classList.toggle('super-file',reward.type==='super');
    const panel=document.createElement('section');panel.className='gacha-file-panel';
    const heading=document.createElement('h2');label(heading,reward.type==='super'?'SUPER FILE!':reward.type==='triple'?'TRIPLE FILE!':'GACHA FILE');
    const counter=document.createElement('div');counter.className='gacha-file-counter';
    const coin=document.createElement('img');coin.src='../sprites/icons/credits.png';coin.alt='Credits';
    const amount=document.createElement('span');amount.textContent='0';counter.append(coin,amount);
    const file=document.createElement('button');file.type='button';file.className='gacha-file-package';file.setAttribute('aria-label','Open File');
    const graphic=document.createElement('img');graphic.src=fileSettings.icon;graphic.alt='Delivery File';file.append(graphic);
    const products=document.createElement('div');products.className='gacha-file-products';products.hidden=true;
    const done=document.createElement('button');done.type='button';done.disabled=true;label(done,'Continue');done.addEventListener('click',close);
    panel.append(heading,counter,file,products,done);dialog.append(panel);dialog.showModal();let started=false,finished=false;
    function reveal(){
      if(finished)return;finished=true;gainCredits(reward.credits);onChange();file.hidden=true;products.hidden=false;done.disabled=false;
      for(const product of reward.products) {
        const card=document.createElement('article');card.className='gacha-file-product';
        const icon=document.createElement('img');icon.src=product.weapon.icon;icon.alt='';
        const name=document.createElement('p');label(name,product.name||product.weapon.name);
        const accept=document.createElement('button'),discard=document.createElement('button');accept.type=discard.type='button';label(accept,'Accept');label(discard,'Drop');
        function resolve(take){if(take&&!acceptFileProduct(getPlayer(),product))return;accept.disabled=discard.disabled=true;card.classList.add('resolved');onChange();}
        accept.addEventListener('click',()=>resolve(true));discard.addEventListener('click',()=>resolve(false));card.append(icon,name,accept,discard);products.append(card);
      }
    }
    file.addEventListener('click',()=>{
      if(started)return;started=true;file.classList.add('opening');const start=performance.now();
      for(let i=0;i<28;i++) {
        const mote=document.createElement('img');mote.src='../sprites/icons/credits.png';mote.alt='';mote.className='gacha-credit-mote';
        mote.style.setProperty('--start-x',`${8+(i*37)%84}%`);mote.style.setProperty('--start-y',`${30+(i*19)%65}%`);mote.style.animationDelay=`${i*.035}s`;dialog.append(mote);
      }
      function tick(now){if(!active)return;const t=Math.min(1,(now-start)/2200);amount.textContent=String(Math.floor(reward.credits*(1-(1-t)**3)));if(t<1)animation=requestAnimationFrame(tick);else reveal();}
      animation=requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    });
    dialog.oncancel=event=>{event.preventDefault();if(finished)close();};
    dialog.oncontextmenu=event=>{event.preventDefault();if(finished)close();};
  }
  function spawn(x,y,forceType){if(drops.size>=fileSettings.maxGround)return false;const point=safeDropLanding(x,y);if(!point)return false;const drop={id:++nextId,...point,forceType};drops.set(drop.id,drop);return drop;}
  return {ready,spawn,get active(){return active;},get count(){return drops.size;},
    roll(enemy){return (enemy.boss===true||['shiroko','iroha','arisu','neru'].includes(enemy.type))&&fileSettings.bossGuaranteed?spawn(enemy.x,enemy.y):false;},
    update(player,previous){if(active)return;const body=getCombatHitbox(player,false);for(const drop of drops.values())if(segmentHitsBody({x:drop.x,y:drop.y,rx:22+body.rx,ry:22+body.ry},previous?.x??player.x,previous?.y??player.y,body.x,body.y)){open(drop);break;}},

import { skillCastSettings } from './game-config.js';

/** List equipped weapon skills and an optional future ultimate, each with its own timer. */
export function equippedSkills(character) {
  return [...(character.attackSlots || []), character.ultimateSkill].filter(skill => skill?.icon && skill.exSkill !== false);
}

/** Find availability only; this does not select or equip a weapon. */
export function readySkill(character) {
  return equippedSkills(character).find(skill => !(skill.skillCooldownRemaining > 0));
}

/** Put a cooldown on the exact weapon that initiated a cast, independently of other weapons. */
export function setSkillCooldown(weapon, seconds) {
  weapon.skillCooldownDuration = seconds;
  weapon.skillCooldownRemaining = seconds;
}

/** Tick each equipped weapon once; global pause freezes these timers in the game loop. */
export function advanceSkillCooldowns(characters, delta) {
  const visited = new Set();
  for (const character of characters) for (const weapon of equippedSkills(character)) {
    if (!weapon || visited.has(weapon)) continue;
    visited.add(weapon);
    weapon.skillCooldownRemaining = Math.max(0, (weapon.skillCooldownRemaining || 0) - Math.max(0, delta));
  }
}

/** Drawing-cast state machine; async recognition responses must match the current token. */
export function createSkillCastState(onSubmit = () => {}) {
  let phase = 'idle', owner = null, weapon = null;
  let elapsed = 0, idle = 0, drawing = false, inkLength = 0, token = 0;
  return {
    get phase() { return phase; }, get owner() { return owner; }, get weapon() { return weapon; },
    get token() { return token; }, get inkLength() { return inkLength; },
    get remaining() { return Math.max(0, skillCastSettings.drawingSeconds - elapsed); },
    begin(character, item, adminTest = false) {
      if (phase !== 'idle' || !item?.icon || (!adminTest && item.skillCooldownRemaining > 0)) return false;
      owner = character; weapon = item; elapsed = idle = inkLength = 0; drawing = false;
      phase = 'drawing'; token++;
      return true;
    },
    strokeStart() { if (phase === 'drawing') { drawing = true; idle = 0; } },
    addInk(length) { if (phase === 'drawing') { inkLength += Math.max(0, length); idle = 0; } },
    strokeEnd() { drawing = false; idle = 0; },
    update(delta) {
      if (phase !== 'drawing') return;
      const time = Math.max(0, delta);
      elapsed += time;
      if (!drawing && inkLength > 0) idle += time;
      if (elapsed >= skillCastSettings.drawingSeconds || idle >= skillCastSettings.idleSubmitSeconds) {
        if (inkLength <= skillCastSettings.minimumInkLength) { this.cancel('empty'); return; }
        phase = 'recognizing'; drawing = false;
        onSubmit({ token, owner, weapon });
      }
    },
    cancel(reason, target = weapon) {
      if (phase === 'idle') return false;
      const penalty = reason === 'pause' ? skillCastSettings.pauseCancelCooldown
        : reason === 'right' ? skillCastSettings.rightCancelCooldown
        : reason === 'empty' ? skillCastSettings.failureCooldown : 0;
      if (penalty && inkLength > 0 && target && equippedSkills(owner).includes(target) &&
          !(target.skillCooldownRemaining > 0)) setSkillCooldown(target, penalty);
      token++; phase = 'idle'; drawing = false;
      return true;
    },
    resolve(requestToken, result) {
      if (requestToken !== token || phase !== 'recognizing') return false;
      let valid = Boolean(result && result.valid !== false && typeof result.label === 'string' && result.label.length > 0 &&
        Number.isFinite(result.score) && result.score >= skillCastSettings.minimumConfidence);
      if (valid && result.weapon) {
        if (!equippedSkills(owner).includes(result.weapon) || (!result.adminTest && result.weapon.skillCooldownRemaining > 0)) valid = false;
        else weapon = result.weapon;
      }
      // Unknown/ambiguous/failed recognition is free; never penalize a guessed weapon.
      if (valid) setSkillCooldown(weapon, skillCastSettings.successCooldown);
      if (valid) {
        weapon.lastSkillDrawing = { label: result.label, score: result.score, skillId: result.skillId, components: result.components,
          accuracy: result.accuracy, damageMultiplier: result.damageMultiplier, clipPredictions: result.clipPredictions };
      }
      phase = 'idle'; token++;
      return Boolean(valid);
    }
  };
}

import { luminousNovaSkillSettings as skill, luminousNovaSettings, damageRules } from './game-config.js';
import { totalCharacterATK, rollAttackDamage } from './combat-stats.js';
import { getCombatHitbox, getEnemyHurtbox } from './combat-hitboxes.js';
import { onEnemyDamage, getAllEnemies, damageEnemy } from './world-state.js';
import { getLuminousNova, luminousNovaHits, drawLuminousPlasma } from './luminous-nova.js';

const buffKey='luminous-nova-ex';

/** Banked bonus only: no extra ATK or critical roll can exceed this component's cap. */
export function luminousNovaFinisherDamage(damageDealt,player) {
  const baseAttack=damageRules.baseScale*totalCharacterATK(player)/100;
  return Math.max(0,Math.min(Math.round(damageDealt*skill.damageFraction),Math.floor(baseAttack*skill.attackCapMultiplier)));
}

/** Nominal281% ATK before the normal damage roll; the banked extra is calculated separately. */
export function luminousNovaFinisherBaseDamage(player) {
  return Math.max(0,Math.round(damageRules.baseScale*skill.finisherAttackMultiplier*totalCharacterATK(player)/100));
}

/** Pure presentation timing; only the active3seconds authorize EX damage. */
export function supernovaBeamPhase(elapsed) {
  const openingDuration = arisBeamVisualSettings.openingSeconds + arisBeamVisualSettings.prelaunchSeconds;
  const beamAge = elapsed-openingDuration;
  return { openingDuration, beamAge,
    damaging: beamAge >= 0 && beamAge < supernovaSkillSettings.duration,
    beamFinished: beamAge >= supernovaSkillSettings.duration * arisBeamVisualSettings.durationMultiplier,
    finished: beamAge >= supernovaSkillSettings.duration * arisBeamVisualSettings.durationMultiplier +
      arisBeamVisualSettings.weaponReturnSeconds };
}


/** Fade and slide out from the player's center, hold through firing/tail, then return. */
export function supernovaWeaponPose(elapsed, player = {label:'Plana',x:0,y:0}, angle = 0) {
  const visual = arisBeamVisualSettings;
  const phase = supernovaBeamPhase(elapsed);
  const smooth = value => { const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, value)); return t*t*(3-2*t); };
  const emerge = smooth(elapsed/visual.openingSeconds);
  const returnStart = phase.openingDuration + supernovaSkillSettings.duration*visual.durationMultiplier;
  const returning = smooth((elapsed-returnStart)/visual.weaponReturnSeconds);
  const progress = emerge*(1-returning);
  return {opacity:progress, offset:(arisBeamOffset(arisBeamAnchor(player),angle,true)-visual.weaponLength/2)*progress,
    length:visual.weaponLength};
}


/** Use the real player collider center, including its vertical sprite offset. */
export function arisBeamAnchor(player) { return getCombatHitbox(player, false); }

/** Automatic beam starts 10px beyond the collider; EX adds its independent muzzle gap. */
export function arisBeamOffset(anchor, angle, special = false) {
  const rx = Math.max(anchor.rx || 0, 0.000001), ry = Math.max(anchor.ry || 0, 0.000001);
  return 1/Math.hypot(Math.cos(angle)/rx,Math.sin(angle)/ry) + supernovaSkillSettings.hitboxGap + (special ? supernovaSkillSettings.extraMuzzleGap : 0);
}

/** Let the drawing identify a ready EX skill; autoattacks never require weapon selection. */
export async function recognizeLoadoutPattern(strokes, skills, recognizer, isCurrent = () => true) {
  let bestMatch = null, bestFailure = null;
  const validMatches = [];
  for (const weapon of skills) {
    if (weapon.skillCooldownRemaining > 0) continue;
    if (!isCurrent()) return { valid: false, cancelled: true };
    const result = await recognizeWeaponPattern(strokes, weapon, recognizer, isCurrent);
    const accuracy = weapon.id === 'aris-laser' ? drawingAccuracy(strokes, supernovaReferenceStrokes()) :
      weapon.id === 'luminous-nova' ? drawingAccuracy(strokes,luminousNovaReferenceStrokes()) : weapon.id === 'plana-umbrella' ? drawingAccuracy(strokes) : 0;
    const candidate = {...result, weapon, matchAccuracy: accuracy};
    if (result.valid) validMatches.push(candidate);
    if (result.valid && (!bestMatch || accuracy > bestMatch.matchAccuracy)) bestMatch = candidate;
    if (!bestFailure || accuracy > bestFailure.matchAccuracy) bestFailure = candidate;
  }
  if (!isCurrent()) return {valid:false,cancelled:true};
  validMatches.sort((a,b)=>b.matchAccuracy-a.matchAccuracy);
  if (validMatches.length > 1 && validMatches[0].matchAccuracy-validMatches[1].matchAccuracy < skillCastSettings.matchMinimumMargin) {
    return {valid:false,reason:'Drawing is ambiguous. Please try again.'};
  }
  return bestMatch || bestFailure || {valid:false,reason:'No ready skill matches this pattern.'};
}


/** Three crown spikes with open underside; a diamond sits above the crown. */
export function supernovaReferenceStrokes() {
  const path = points => points.map(([x,y]) => ({x,y}));


/** Choose a cancellation target locally; empty/unrelated ink never selects a default slot. */
export function closestDrawingSkill(strokes, skills) {
  if (!drawingBounds(strokes)) return null;
  let best = null, score = .25, runnerUp = 0;
  for (const weapon of skills) {
    if (weapon.skillCooldownRemaining > 0) continue;
    const reference = weapon.id === 'luminous-nova'?luminousNovaReferenceStrokes():weapon.id === 'aris-laser' ? supernovaReferenceStrokes() : undefined;
    if (!reference && weapon.id !== 'plana-umbrella') continue;
    const accuracy = drawingAccuracy(strokes, reference);
    if (accuracy > score) { runnerUp = score === .25 ? 0 : score; score = accuracy; best = weapon; }
    else runnerUp = Math.max(runnerUp,accuracy);
  }
  return score-runnerUp >= skillCastSettings.matchMinimumMargin ? best : null;
}


/** A circle enclosing a centered diamond; scale, stroke order and direction are unrestricted. */
export function luminousNovaReferenceStrokes() {
  return [Array.from({length:97},(_,i)=>({x:100+90*Math.cos(i/96*Math.PI*2),y:100+90*Math.sin(i/96*Math.PI*2)})),
    [[100,48],[152,100],[100,152],[48,100],[100,48]].map(([x,y])=>({x,y}))];
}

/** Separate enclosing ink from diamond ink before combining forgiving geometry and AI assistance. */
export async function recognizeLuminousNovaPattern(strokes,recognizer,isCurrent=()=>true) {
  const normalized=normalizeSkillStrokes(strokes),points=[];
  for(const stroke of normalized)for(let i=1;i<stroke.length;i++) {
    const a=stroke[i-1],b=stroke[i],count=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(Math.hypot(b.x-a.x,b.y-a.y)/3));
    for(let j=0;j<=count;j++)points.push({x:a.x+(b.x-a.x)*j/count,y:a.y+(b.y-a.y)*j/count});
  }
  if(!points.length)return {valid:false,reason:'Draw a circle with a diamond inside.'};
  const radius=p=>Math.hypot((p.x-100)/100,(p.y-100)/100);
  const outer=points.filter(p=>radius(p)>.87),inner=points.filter(p=>radius(p)<.84);
  const sectors=new Set(outer.map(p=>(Math.floor((Math.atan2(p.y-100,p.x-100)+Math.PI)/Math.PI*4)+8)%8));
  const bounds=drawingBounds([inner]);
  if(sectors.size<7||!bounds||bounds.right-bounds.left<40||bounds.bottom-bounds.top<40)return {valid:false,reason:'Draw an enclosing circle and a centered diamond.'};
  const cx=(bounds.left+bounds.right)/2,cy=(bounds.top+bounds.bottom)/2;
  const rx=(bounds.right-bounds.left)/2,ry=(bounds.bottom-bounds.top)/2;
  const error=inner.reduce((sum,p)=>sum+Math.abs(Math.abs(p.x-cx)/rx+Math.abs(p.y-cy)/ry-1),0)/inner.length;
  if(Math.abs(cx-100)>25||Math.abs(cy-100)>25||error>.23)return {valid:false,reason:'Draw a diamond outline inside the circle.'};
  const accuracy=drawingAccuracy(strokes,luminousNovaReferenceStrokes());
  if(accuracy<luminousNovaSkillSettings.patternMinimumAccuracy)return {valid:false,reason:'Complete the circle and diamond.'};
  const components=[];
  for(const [name,ink] of [['circle',outer],['diamond',inner]]) {
    if(!isCurrent())return {valid:false,cancelled:true};
    try{components.push({name,predictions:await recognizer?.recognize(drawingModelImage([ink]))});}catch{}
  }
  if(!isCurrent())return {valid:false,cancelled:true};
  return {valid:true,skillId:'luminous-nova-aura',label:'Luminous Nova',score:accuracy,accuracy,damageMultiplier:1,components};
}
export function createArisAttack() {
  let autoattackEnabled = true;
  let special = null;
  let owner = null, cooldown = 0, clock = 0, volleys = [];

  const s = arisWeaponSettings;
  const image = new Image();

    /** Start a continuous, independently aimable EX; shared per-target cooldown prevents frame damage. */
    cast(player, angle, damageMultiplier = 1.5, getAngle = () => angle) {
      if (owner !== player) { clear(); owner = player; }
      volleys = []; // Cancel the current automatic beam before the EX opening.
      special = { player, angle, getAngle, damageMultiplier, elapsed: 0, hits: new Map() };
    },
    update(delta, player, aim) {
      if (!getArisWeapon(player)) { clear(); return; }
      if (owner !== player) { clear(); owner = player; }
      clock += delta;
      if (special) {
        special.elapsed += delta;
        special.angle = special.getAngle();
        if (supernovaBeamPhase(special.elapsed).finished || special.player !== player) special = null;
      }
      for (const [id, time] of hitTimes) if (clock-time > s.hitCooldown+s.beamSeconds) hitTimes.delete(id);
      if (autoattackEnabled && !special) cooldown = Math.max(0, cooldown - delta);
      if (autoattackEnabled && !special && cooldown <= 0) {
        const stats = arisLevelStats(player);
        volleys.push({ elapsed: 0, angles: stats.beams === 2 ? [aim, aim + Math.PI] : [aim],
          width: s.beamWidth * stats.size, origin: arisBeamAnchor(player) });
        cooldown = attackTimeFormula(stats.interval, ensureCombatStats(player).hastePercent);
      }
      const active = [...volleys];
      if (special && supernovaBeamPhase(special.elapsed).damaging) active.push({ elapsed: special.elapsed, angles: [special.angle], width: supernovaSkillSettings.beamWidth,

      for (const volley of active) {
        const start = volley.elapsed;
        volley.elapsed += delta;

          const times = volley.special ? special.hits : hitTimes;
          const lastHit = times.get(enemy.id);
          if (lastHit !== undefined && clock - lastHit < (volley.special ? supernovaSkillSettings.hitCooldown : s.hitCooldown) - 1e-8) continue;
          const angle = volley.angles.find(value => arisBeamHits(enemy, volley.origin, value, volley.width));
          if (angle === undefined) continue;
          times.set(enemy.id, clock); // A missed attack also cannot reroll every frame.
          const hit = rollArisDamage(player, Math.random, enemy, volley.special ? special.damageMultiplier : 1);
          const landed = damageEnemy(enemy.id, hit.damage, player, hit.type, { canMiss: true });
          const living = getEnemy(enemy.id);
          if (landed !== false && living) {
            if (volley.special) {
              const control = supernovaKnockback(living, volley.origin, angle, volley.width);
              applySkillControl(living, control.x, control.y, supernovaSkillSettings.knockbackSeconds,

                { ignoreKnockbackResistance: supernovaSkillSettings.ignoreKnockbackResistance });

            }
          }
        }
      }
      volleys = volleys.filter(volley => volley.elapsed < s.beamSeconds * arisBeamVisualSettings.durationMultiplier);

/** Canonical pattern matching the EX Skills reference diagram. */
export function planaReferenceStrokes() {

  [{ x: 125, y: 119 }, { x: 75, y: 160 }]];

/** Uniformly sample ink length, ignoring pen speed, stroke order and direction. */
function normalizedInk(strokes) {
  strokes = normalizeSkillStrokes(strokes);
  const bounds = drawingBounds(strokes);
  if (!bounds) return [];
  const size = Math.max(bounds.right - bounds.left, bounds.bottom - bounds.top, 1);

      x: (a.x + (b.x - a.x) * j / count - (bounds.left + bounds.right) / 2) / size,
      y: (a.y + (b.y - a.y) * j / count - (bounds.top + bounds.bottom) / 2) / size
    });
  }

export const adminDigitTemplates = {
  1: [path([[30, 20], [50, 0], [50, 100]])],
  2: [path([[0, 15], [20, 0], [70, 0], [95, 20], [90, 40], [0, 100], [100, 100]])],
  3: [path([[0, 0], [80, 0], [100, 20], [70, 50], [35, 50], [80, 50], [100, 75], [80, 100], [0, 100]])],
  4: [path([[70, 0], [0, 65], [100, 65]]), path([[70, 0], [70, 100]])],

/** Match handwritten 1Ã¢â‚¬â€œ6 locally, without downloading or calling either AI model. */
export function recognizeAdminDigit(strokes) {
  const bounds = drawingBounds(strokes);
  if (!bounds) return null;
  const width = bounds.right - bounds.left, height = bounds.bottom - bounds.top;
  if (height > 0 && width / height < .18) return 1;
  const ranked = Object.entries(adminDigitTemplates).map(([digit, template]) =>
    ({ digit: Number(digit), score: drawingAccuracy(strokes, template) })).sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
  return ranked[0].score >= .45 && ranked[0].score - ranked[1].score >= .025 ? ranked[0].digit : null;
}

/** Resolve a slot only when it contains a weapon with an implemented EX effect. */
export function adminSkillResult(player, slot) {
  const weapon = player.attackSlots?.[slot];
  const skillId = skillIds[weapon?.id];
  return skillId ? { valid: true, adminTest: true, weapon, skillId,
    label: weapon.name || weapon.id, score: 1, accuracy: skillCastSettings.accuracyAverage,
    damageMultiplier: skillCastSettings.damageAverage, components: [] }
    : { valid: false, reason: `Slot ${slot + 1} has no implemented EX skill.` };
}
