import { createArisAttack } from './aris-weapon.js';
import { luminousNovaFinisherDamage } from './luminous-nova-skill.js';
import { luminousNovaSkillSettings,arisWeaponSettings,princessKeySkillSettings as settings } from './game-config.js';
import { onEnemyDamage,getAllEnemies,damageEnemy } from './world-state.js';
import { getEnemyHurtbox } from './combat-hitboxes.js';
import { rollAttackDamage,totalWeaponDamage } from './combat-stats.js';

/** Kei's temporary amplifier plus Supernova's aimable beam, with delayed impact residues. */
export function createPrincessKeySkill({random=Math.random}={}) {
  let state=null,residues=[];const buffKey='princess-key-ex';
  const weapon=player=>player.attackSlots?.find(w=>w?.id==='princess-key');
  const beam=createArisAttack({getWeapon:weapon,specialHitCooldown:settings.hitCooldown,
    rollSpecialDamage(player,target,multiplier) {
      const hit=rollAttackDamage(player,totalWeaponDamage(player,'princess-key',arisWeaponSettings.damageMultiplier,[],
        {projectileCount:1,hitCooldownFrames:30}),random,{target,damageMod:multiplier});
      hit.damage+=luminousNovaFinisherDamage(state?.damageDealt||0,player);return hit;
    },
    onSpecialHit(target,hit,player) {
      const body=getEnemyHurtbox(target),charge=luminousNovaFinisherDamage(state?.damageDealt||0,player);
      // One residue per target per cast prevents rapid beam ticks creating thousands of effects.
      const existing=residues.find(r=>r.target===target&&r.cast===state);
      if(existing){existing.damage=Math.max(existing.damage,charge);return;}
      residues.push({target,cast:state,owner:player,x:body.x,y:body.y,age:0,damage:charge,exploded:false});
    }});
  beam.setAutoattackEnabled(false);
  const unsubscribe=onEnemyDamage(({source,damage})=>{
    if(state&&state.elapsed<settings.buffSeconds&&source===state.owner)state.damageDealt+=Math.max(0,damage);
  });
  function removeBuff(){if(state?.owner.combatBuffs)delete state.owner.combatBuffs[buffKey];}
  function reset(){removeBuff();state=null;residues=[];beam.reset();}
  function cast(player,angle,multiplier=1.5,getAngle=()=>angle) {
    reset();player.combatBuffs??={};player.combatBuffs[buffKey]={damageBonusMultiplier:luminousNovaSkillSettings.damageBonus,critPercent:luminousNovaSkillSettings.critBonus};
    state={owner:player,elapsed:0,damageDealt:0};beam.cast(player,angle,multiplier,getAngle);
  }
  /** Substep beam ticks and residue timers on simulation time, so pausing freezes everything. */
  function update(delta,player,aim=0) {
    if(state&&(state.owner!==player||!weapon(player))){reset();return;}
    let left=Math.max(0,delta);
    while(left>1e-8) {
      const step=Math.min(left,1/60);left-=step;
      if(state){state.elapsed+=step;if(state.elapsed>=settings.buffSeconds)removeBuff();beam.update(step,player,aim);}
      for(const residue of residues) {
        residue.age+=step;
        if(!residue.exploded&&residue.age>=settings.residueSeconds) {
          residue.exploded=true;
          for(const enemy of getAllEnemies()) {
            const body=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy);
            if(Math.hypot(body.x-residue.x,body.y-residue.y)<=settings.residueRadius+Math.max(body.rx,body.ry))
              damageEnemy(enemy.id,residue.damage,residue.owner,'normal');
          }
        }
      }
      residues=residues.filter(r=>r.age<settings.residueSeconds+.4);
      if(state&&state.elapsed>=settings.buffSeconds&&!residues.length){removeBuff();state=null;beam.reset();}
    }
  }
  function draw(context,camera) {
    beam.draw(context,camera);
    if(state&&state.elapsed<settings.buffSeconds) {
      const p=state.owner,size=p.spriteSize||89.6;
      context.save();context.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
      for(let i=0;i<16;i++) {
        const t=(state.elapsed/1.8+i*.618)%1,x=p.x-camera.x+Math.sin(i*2.4)*size*.4,y=p.y-camera.y+size*.4-t*size;
        context.globalAlpha=Math.sin(t*Math.PI)*.6;context.fillStyle=i%2?'#ff9de3':'#a0edff';
        context.beginPath();context.arc(x,y,2*(1-t*.5),0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();
      }
      context.restore();
    }
    for(const residue of residues) {
      const t=residue.exploded?Math.min(1,(residue.age-settings.residueSeconds)/.4):residue.age/settings.residueSeconds;
      const radius=residue.exploded?settings.residueRadius*(.25+.75*t):18+6*t;
      context.save();context.translate(residue.x-camera.x,residue.y-camera.y);context.globalAlpha=residue.exploded?(1-t)*.5:.28;
      const glow=context.createRadialGradient(0,0,0,0,0,radius);glow.addColorStop(0,'#ffb7ef');glow.addColorStop(.6,'#afadff88');glow.addColorStop(1,'#ff70d000');
      context.fillStyle=glow;context.beginPath();context.arc(0,0,radius,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();context.restore();
    }
  }
  return {ready:beam.ready,cast,update,draw,reset,dispose(){reset();unsubscribe();},
    get auraActive(){return Boolean(state&&state.elapsed<settings.buffSeconds);},get damageDealt(){return state?.damageDealt||0;},get residueCount(){return residues.length;}};
}

VERBATIM AGGREGATED_OUTPUT:
import { segmentPlanaPattern } from './plana-pattern.js';
import { drawingModelImage, drawingBounds, normalizeSkillStrokes } from './skill-drawing.js';
import { drawingAccuracy, skillDamageMultiplier } from './skill-accuracy.js';
import { skillCastSettings, luminousNovaSkillSettings } from './game-config.js';

/** Require interior ink in both symbol regions before allowing CLIP to rescue rough geometry. */
function hasBothSymbols(strokes) {
  const b = drawingBounds(strokes);
  if (!b) return false;
  const cx = (b.left + b.right) / 2, cy = (b.top + b.bottom) / 2;
  const w = b.right - b.left, h = b.bottom - b.top;
  if (!(w > 0) || !(h > 0)) return false;
  const inner = strokes.flat().filter(p => Math.hypot((p.x-cx)/(w/2), (p.y-cy)/(h/2)) < .76);
  return inner.some(p => p.y < cy && p.x < cx-w*.04) &&
    inner.some(p => p.y < cy && p.x > cx+w*.04) &&
    inner.some(p => p.y > cy && p.x < cx-w*.04) &&
    inner.some(p => p.y > cy && p.x > cx+w*.04);
}

/** Combine full-symbol CLIP, isolated QuickDraw parts and forgiving spatial validation. */
export async function recognizeWeaponPattern(strokes, weapon, recognizer, isCurrent = () => true) {
  if(weapon?.id==='princess-key')return recognizePrincessKeyPattern(strokes,recognizer,isCurrent);
  if (weapon?.id === 'luminous-nova') return recognizeLuminousNovaPattern(strokes,recognizer,isCurrent);
  if (weapon?.id === 'aris-laser') return recognizeSupernovaPattern(strokes, recognizer, isCurrent);
  if (weapon?.id !== 'plana-umbrella') return { valid: false, reason: 'No drawing skill is defined for this weapon yet.' };
  if (!isCurrent()) return { valid: false, cancelled: true };
  strokes = normalizeSkillStrokes(strokes);
  const pattern = segmentPlanaPattern(strokes);
  const accuracy = drawingAccuracy(strokes);
  let clipPredictions = [], clipError;
  try {
    if (recognizer.recognizeSymbol) clipPredictions = await recognizer.recognizeSymbol(drawingModelImage(strokes));
  } catch (error) {
    // Download/inference failure must not disable an otherwise recognized geometric cast.
    clipError = error.message;
  }
  if (!isCurrent()) return { valid: false, cancelled: true };
  const clipMatch = clipPredictions[0]?.label === 'a hand drawn circle enclosing an arrow above an X cross' &&
    clipPredictions[0].score >= skillCastSettings.clipMinimumScore;
  const rescued = clipMatch && accuracy >= skillCastSettings.referenceMinimum && hasBothSymbols(strokes);
  if (!pattern.valid && !rescued) return { ...pattern, clipPredictions, accuracy };
  const components = [];
  // When geometry cannot reliably split rough ink, ask QuickDraw about the whole sketch.
  const parts = pattern.valid ? pattern.parts : [{ name: 'whole pattern', strokes }];
  for (const part of parts) {
    if (!isCurrent()) return { valid: false, cancelled: true };
    try {
      const predictions = await recognizer.recognize(drawingModelImage(part.strokes));
      components.push({ name: part.name, predictions });
    } catch (error) {
      components.push({ name: part.name, predictions: [], error: error.message });
    }
  }
  if (!isCurrent()) return { valid: false, cancelled: true };
  return { valid: true, skillId: 'plana-umbrella-launch', label: 'Plana: Umbrella Launch',
    score: pattern.valid ? pattern.score : clipPredictions[0].score,
    accuracy, damageMultiplier: skillDamageMultiplier(accuracy), components, clipPredictions, clipError };
}


/** Let the drawing identify a ready EX skill; autoattacks never require weapon selection. */
export async function recognizeLoadoutPattern(strokes, skills, recognizer, isCurrent = () => true) {
  let bestMatch = null, bestFailure = null;
  const validMatches = [];
  for (const weapon of skills) {
    if (weapon.skillCooldownRemaining > 0) continue;
    if (!isCurrent()) return { valid: false, cancelled: true };
    const result = await recognizeWeaponPattern(strokes, weapon, recognizer, isCurrent);
    const accuracy = weapon.id==='princess-key'?drawingAccuracy(strokes,princessKeyReferenceStrokes()):weapon.id === 'aris-laser' ? drawingAccuracy(strokes, supernovaReferenceStrokes()) :
      weapon.id === 'luminous-nova' ? drawingAccuracy(strokes,luminousNovaReferenceStrokes()) : weapon.id === 'plana-umbrella' ? drawingAccuracy(strokes) : 0;
    const candidate = {...result, weapon, matchAccuracy: accuracy};
    if (result.valid) validMatches.push(candidate);
    if (result.valid && (!bestMatch || accuracy > bestMatch.matchAccuracy)) bestMatch = candidate;
    if (!bestFailure || accuracy > bestFailure.matchAccuracy) bestFailure = candidate;
  }
  if (!isCurrent()) return {valid:false,cancelled:true};
  validMatches.sort((a,b)=>b.matchAccuracy-a.matchAccuracy);
  if (validMatches.length > 1 && validMatches[0].matchAccuracy-validMatches[1].matchAccuracy < skillCastSettings.matchMinimumMargin) {
    return {valid:false,reason:'Drawing is ambiguous. Please try again.'};
  }
  return bestMatch || bestFailure || {valid:false,reason:'No ready skill matches this pattern.'};
}


/** Three crown spikes with open underside; a diamond sits above the crown. */
export function supernovaReferenceStrokes() {
  const path = points => points.map(([x,y]) => ({x,y}));
}

/** Symmetric ink distance rewards the entire reference, including missing/extra marks. */
export function drawingAccuracy(strokes, referenceStrokes = planaReferenceStrokes()) {
  const actual = normalizedInk(strokes), reference = normalizedInk(referenceStrokes);
  if (!actual.length) return 0;
  const nearestMean = (from, to) => from.reduce((total, p) => total +
    Math.min(...to.map(q => Math.hypot(p.x - q.x, p.y - q.y))), 0) / from.length;
  const error = (nearestMean(actual, reference) + nearestMean(reference, actual)) / 2;
  return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, 1 - error / skillCastSettings.accuracyDistanceTolerance));
}

/** Map successful reference accuracy to minimum/typical/perfect damage anchors. */
export function skillDamageMultiplier(accuracy) {
  const s = skillCastSettings;
  const value = Number.isFinite(accuracy) ? accuracy : s.accuracyAverage;
  const low = value <= s.accuracyAverage;
  const start = low ? s.accuracyMinimum : s.accuracyAverage;
  const end = low ? s.accuracyAverage : s.accuracyPerfect;
  const from = low ? s.damageMinimum : s.damageAverage;
  const to = low ? s.damageAverage : s.damageMaximum;
  return from + (to - from) * Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (value - start) / (end - start)));
}

import { princessKeySettings as settings, luminousNovaSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { rollAttackDamage, totalWeaponDamage } from './combat-stats.js';
import { getAllEnemies, getEnemy, damageEnemy } from './world-state.js';
import { getCombatHitbox } from './combat-hitboxes.js';
import { luminousNovaHits, drawLuminousPlasma } from './luminous-nova.js';
import { applySkillControl } from './enemy-control.js';

/** Stagger four independently critting rounds across each three-frame cycle; ignore Haste. */
export function createPrincessKeyAttack({random=Math.random}={}) {
  let bullets=[],owner=null,cooldown=0,enabled=true,shots=0,gaps=[],shotIndex=0;
  function reset(){bullets=[];owner=null;cooldown=0;shots=0;gaps=[];shotIndex=0;}
  function update(delta,player,aim=0,viewport=null) {
    if(!player.attackSlots?.some(w=>w?.id==='princess-key')){reset();return;}
    if(owner!==player){reset();owner=player;}
    if(!enabled||delta<=0)return;
    const body=getCombatHitbox(player,false);
    const view=viewport||{x:body.x-640,y:body.y-360,width:1280,height:720};
    let remaining=delta;
    while(remaining>1e-8) {
      if(cooldown<=1e-8) {
        const body=getCombatHitbox(player,false);
        if(shotIndex===0) {
          // Positive randomized gaps sum to exactly one base cycle, preserving total fire rate.
          const weights=Array.from({length:settings.attackCount},()=>.7+random()*.6);
          const total=weights.reduce((sum,value)=>sum+value,0);
          gaps=weights.map(value=>settings.interval*value/total);
        }
        {
          const angle=aim+(random()-.5)*settings.spreadRadians;
          const dx=Math.cos(angle),dy=Math.sin(angle);
          const offset=1/Math.hypot(dx/body.rx,dy/body.ry)+3+settings.diameter*1.8;
          bullets.push({x:body.x+dx*offset,y:body.y+dy*offset,angle,speed:settings.speed,age:0,hits:new Map(),hitCount:0});shots++;
        }
        cooldown=gaps[shotIndex];shotIndex=(shotIndex+1)%settings.attackCount;
      }
      const step=Math.min(remaining,cooldown,1/60),enemies=getAllEnemies();
      for(let i=bullets.length-1;i>=0;i--) {
        const bullet=bullets[i],from={x:bullet.x,y:bullet.y},dt=step;
        bullet.age+=dt;bullet.x+=Math.cos(bullet.angle)*settings.speed*dt;bullet.y+=Math.sin(bullet.angle)*settings.speed*dt;
        for(const enemy of enemies) {
          if(bullet.hitCount>=settings.hitLimit)break;
          if(bullet.age-(bullet.hits.get(enemy.id)??-Infinity)<settings.hitCooldown||!luminousNovaHits(enemy,from,bullet,settings.diameter*1.8))continue;
          bullet.hits.set(enemy.id,bullet.age);bullet.hitCount++;
          const hit=rollAttackDamage(player,totalWeaponDamage(player,'princess-key',settings.damageMultiplier,[],{projectileCount:4,hitCooldownFrames:15}),random,{target:enemy});
          const landed=damageEnemy(enemy.id,hit.damage,player,hit.type,{canMiss:true,damageGroup:'princess-key'}),living=getEnemy(enemy.id);
          if(landed!==false&&living)applySkillControl(living,Math.cos(bullet.angle)*settings.knockbackSpeed*settings.knockbackSeconds,
            Math.sin(bullet.angle)*settings.knockbackSpeed*settings.knockbackSeconds,settings.knockbackSeconds,settings.knockbackSeconds);
        }
        if(princessBulletOffscreen(bullet,view)||bullet.hitCount>=settings.hitLimit)bullets.splice(i,1);
      }
      remaining-=step;cooldown=Math.max(0,cooldown-step);
    }
  }
  return {ready:Promise.resolve(),reset,update,
    // Reuse Kei's actual plasma renderer: identical pink bloom and continuous tapered tail.
    draw(context,camera){for(const bullet of bullets)drawLuminousPlasma(context,camera,bullet,settings.diameter,Infinity);},
    setAutoattackEnabled(value){enabled=Boolean(value);if(!enabled)bullets=[];},
    get shotsFired(){return shots;},get projectileCount(){return bullets.length;}};
}

/** Despawn only after the complete head bloom and continuous tail clear the current camera. */
export function princessBulletOffscreen(bullet,view) {
  const radius=settings.diameter/2,padding=radius*luminousNovaSettings.bloomRadiusScale;
  const length=Math.min(radius*(1+luminousNovaSettings.trailLengthRatio),settings.speed*bullet.age);
  const tailX=bullet.x-Math.cos(bullet.angle)*length,tailY=bullet.y-Math.sin(bullet.angle)*length;
  return Math.max(bullet.x,tailX)+padding<view.x||Math.min(bullet.x,tailX)-padding>view.x+view.width||
    Math.max(bullet.y,tailY)+padding<view.y||Math.min(bullet.y,tailY)-padding>view.y+view.height;
}
    opacity:.18*(1-progress*.5)*(.94+.06*Math.sin(age*4)),exploded:false};
}

/** Kei's temporary amplifier plus Supernova's aimable beam, with delayed impact residues. */
export function createPrincessKeySkill({random=Math.random}={}) {
  let state=null,residues=[];const buffKey='princess-key-ex';
  const weapon=player=>player.attackSlots?.find(w=>w?.id==='princess-key');
  const beam=createArisAttack({getWeapon:weapon,specialHitCooldown:settings.hitCooldown,
    rollSpecialDamage(player,target,multiplier) {
      const hit=rollAttackDamage(player,totalWeaponDamage(player,'princess-key',arisWeaponSettings.damageMultiplier,[],
        {projectileCount:1,hitCooldownFrames:30}),random,{target,damageMod:multiplier});
      hit.damage+=luminousNovaFinisherDamage(state?.damageDealt||0,player);return hit;
    },
    onSpecialHit(target,hit,player) {
      if(!state)return;
      const body=getEnemyHurtbox(target),charge=luminousNovaFinisherDamage(state?.damageDealt||0,player);
      // One residue per target per cast prevents rapid beam ticks creating thousands of effects.
      const existing=residues.find(r=>r.target===target&&r.cast===state);
      if(existing){existing.damage=Math.max(existing.damage,charge);return;}
      residues.push({target,cast:state,owner:player,x:body.x,y:body.y,age:0,damage:charge,exploded:false});
    }});
  beam.setAutoattackEnabled(false);
  const unsubscribe=onEnemyDamage(({source,damage})=>{

/** Boss delivery packages, a paused opening sequence, and individually accepted/dropped products. */
export function createGachaFiles({canvas,getPlayer,onOpen=()=>{},onChange=()=>{}}) {

import { font21Metrics } from './font21-metrics.js';
import { font2Metrics } from './font2-metrics.js';
import { thinFontMetrics } from './font-thin-metrics.js';
import { fontMetrics } from './font-metrics.js';

/** Return tight glyph bounds so only the dark outlines meet between letters. */
export function glyphRectangle(character) {
  return fontMetrics[character] || fontMetrics['?'];
}

/** Render crisp HUD text from the supplied font sheet, refreshing only on changes. */
export function createBitmapText(canvas, { scale = 2, outlineOverlap = 1, spaceWidth = 3, fitWidth = null, variant = 'regular', maxWidth = null, wrap = true } = {}) {
  const image = new Image();
  let loaded = false;
  let text = '';
  const sourceScale = variant === 'font21' ? .25 : 1;
  const lineHeight = variant === 'font21' ? 24 : 20;
  const glyphFor = character => variant === 'font21' ? font21Metrics[character] || font21Metrics['?'] : variant === 'font2' ? font2Metrics[character] || font2Metrics['?'] : variant === 'thin' ? thinFontMetrics[character] || thinFontMetrics['?'] : glyphRectangle(character);

  function render() {
    // EDIT scale/outlineOverlap via options: 2x glyphs, one source outline pixel overlap.
    const lines = [''];
    const measure = value => [...value].reduce((sum, c) => sum + (c === ' ' ? spaceWidth : glyphFor(c).width * sourceScale - outlineOverlap), outlineOverlap) * scale;
    for (const word of text.split(' ')) {
      const index = lines.length - 1;
      const next = lines[index] ? `${lines[index]} ${word}` : word;
      if (wrap && maxWidth && lines[index] && measure(next) > maxWidth) lines.push(word);
      else lines[index] = next;
    }
    canvas.width = Math.max(1, ...lines.map(measure));
    canvas.height = lineHeight * scale * lines.length;
    canvas.style.width = fitWidth || `${canvas.width}px`;
    canvas.style.height = fitWidth ? 'auto' : `${canvas.height}px`;
    canvas.setAttribute('aria-label', text);
    if (!loaded) return;
    const context = canvas.getContext('2d');
    context.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
    lines.forEach((line, row) => {
      let x = 0;
      for (const character of line) {
        if (character !== ' ') {
          const glyph = glyphFor(character);
          context.drawImage(image, glyph.x, glyph.y, glyph.width, glyph.height,
            x * scale, (row * lineHeight + glyph.offsetY * sourceScale) * scale, glyph.width * sourceScale * scale, glyph.height * sourceScale * scale);
        }
        x += character === ' ' ? spaceWidth : glyphFor(character).width * sourceScale - outlineOverlap;
      }
    });
  }

  image.onload = () => { loaded = true; render(); };
  image.src = new URL(variant === 'font21' ? '../sprites/font2.1.png' : variant === 'font2' ? '../sprites/font2.png' : variant === 'thin' ? '../sprites/font-thin.png' : '../sprites/font.png', import.meta.url).href;
  return {
    setMaxWidth(value) { maxWidth = value; render(); },
    setText(value) {
      if (text === value) return;
      text = value;
      render();
    }
  };
}

login-splash.js
/** Rotate the login art without disturbing the form or its diagonal background fade. */
function startLoginSplash() {
  const container=document.querySelector('.login-splash');
  if(!container)return;
  const images=[...container.querySelectorAll('img')];
  let current=0,timer=null,transitioning=false;

  /** Reveal the next decoded image from the left over the still-visible current artwork. */
  function showNext() {
    if(document.hidden||transitioning)return;
    const next=(current+1)%images.length;
    if(!images[next].complete||!images[next].naturalWidth)return;
    transitioning=true;
    images[next].classList.add('is-entering');
  }

  /** Promote the incoming layer only after its reveal finishes, avoiding a blank frame. */
  container.addEventListener('animationend',event=>{
    if(!event.target.classList.contains('is-entering'))return;
    images[current].classList.remove('is-current');
    current=images.indexOf(event.target);
    images[current].classList.add('is-current');
    images[current].classList.remove('is-entering');
    transitioning=false;
  });

  /** Restart the ten-second interval after returning to the tab; never queue missed changes. */
  function resume() {
    clearInterval(timer);
    if(!document.hidden)timer=setInterval(showNext,10000);
  }
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',resume);
  window.addEventListener('pagehide',()=>clearInterval(timer));
  window.addEventListener('pageshow',resume);
  // Decode up front so a large splash cannot flash or stall when first revealed.
  Promise.allSettled(images.map(image=>image.decode())).then(resume);
}

VERBATIM FILE CHANGE | D:\code\AI Applications\TERM Project\Development\firing-rings.js | content:
/** Common growth keeps the outer rings strictly larger despite their staggered appearances. */
export function firingRingPoses(elapsed,size) {
  const growth=1+Math.min(1,Math.max(0,elapsed)/.5)*1.5;
  return Array.from({length:3},(_,i)=>{
    const age=elapsed-i*.045,t=age/.42;
    return {visible:age>=0&&t<1,x:i*22+Math.max(0,elapsed)*55,
      radius:size*(.65+i*.5)*growth,opacity:Math.max(0,1-t)**2*.75};
  });
}

/** Soft double-stroked muzzle shock rings; local impact only, no screen flash. */
export function drawFiringRings(context,x,y,angle,elapsed,size,blue=false) {
  const rings=firingRingPoses(elapsed,size);if(!rings.some(r=>r.visible))return;
  context.save();context.translate(x,y);context.rotate(angle);context.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';context.shadowBlur=0;
  for(const ring of rings) {
    if(!ring.visible)continue;context.globalAlpha=ring.opacity;context.beginPath();
    for(let point=0;point<=32;point++) {
      const a=point/32*Math.PI*2,px=ring.x+Math.cos(a)*ring.radius*.3,py=Math.sin(a)*ring.radius;
      if(point===0)context.moveTo(px,py);else context.lineTo(px,py);
    }
    context.strokeStyle=blue?'rgba(75,190,255,.4)':'rgba(255,100,220,.4)';context.lineWidth=6;context.stroke();
    context.strokeStyle=blue?'#e5fcff':'#ffe9fc';context.lineWidth=1.6;context.stroke();
  }
  context.restore();
}

import { createArisAttack,supernovaBeamPhase } from './aris-weapon.js';
import { luminousNovaFinisherDamage } from './luminous-nova-skill.js';
import { luminousNovaSkillSettings,arisWeaponSettings,supernovaSkillSettings,princessKeySkillSettings as settings } from './game-config.js';
import { onEnemyDamage,getAllEnemies,damageEnemy } from './world-state.js';
import { getEnemyHurtbox } from './combat-hitboxes.js';
import { rollAttackDamage,totalWeaponDamage } from './combat-stats.js';

/** Gentle blue residue pulse, followed by an inward collapse at the four-second detonation. */
export function princessResiduePose(age) {
  const progress=Math.min(1,age/settings.residueSeconds);
  if(age>=settings.residueSeconds) {
    const t=Math.min(1,(age-settings.residueSeconds)/.4);
    return {radius:6+(settings.residueRadius-6)*(1-(1-t)**3),opacity:.24*(1-t)**2,exploded:true};
  }
  const collapse=Math.max(0,(age-(settings.residueSeconds-.4))/.4);
  return {radius:Math.max(1,24*(.96+.04*Math.sin(age*4))*(1-collapse*collapse)),
    opacity:.18*(1-progress*.5)*(.94+.06*Math.sin(age*4)),exploded:false};
}

/** Kei's temporary amplifier plus Supernova's aimable beam, with delayed impact residues. */
export function createPrincessKeySkill({random=Math.random}={}) {
  let state=null,residues=[];const buffKey='princess-key-ex';
  const weapon=player=>player.attackSlots?.find(w=>w?.id==='princess-key');
  const beam=createArisAttack({getWeapon:weapon,specialHitCooldown:settings.hitCooldown,
    rollSpecialDamage(player,target,multiplier) {
      const hit=rollAttackDamage(player,totalWeaponDamage(player,'princess-key',arisWeaponSettings.damageMultiplier,[],
        {projectileCount:1,hitCooldownFrames:settings.hitCooldown*60}),random,{target,damageMod:multiplier});
      hit.damage+=luminousNovaFinisherDamage(state?.damageDealt||0,player);return hit;
    },
    onSpecialHit(target,hit,player) {
      if(!state)return;
      const body=getEnemyHurtbox(target),charge=luminousNovaFinisherDamage(state?.damageDealt||0,player);
      // One residue per target per cast prevents rapid beam ticks creating thousands of effects.
      const existing=residues.find(r=>r.target===target&&r.cast===state);
      if(existing){existing.damage=Math.max(existing.damage,charge);return;}
      residues.push({target,cast:state,owner:player,x:body.x,y:body.y,age:0,damage:charge,exploded:false});
    }});
  beam.setAutoattackEnabled(false);
  const unsubscribe=onEnemyDamage(({source,damage})=>{
    if(state&&state.elapsed<settings.buffSeconds&&source===state.owner)state.damageDealt+=Math.max(0,damage);
  });
  function removeBuff(){if(state?.owner.combatBuffs)delete state.owner.combatBuffs[buffKey];}
  function reset(){removeBuff();state=null;residues=[];beam.reset();}
  function cast(player,angle,multiplier=1.5,getAngle=()=>angle) {
    reset();player.combatBuffs??={};player.combatBuffs[buffKey]={damageBonusMultiplier:luminousNovaSkillSettings.damageBonus,critPercent:luminousNovaSkillSettings.critBonus};
    state={owner:player,elapsed:0,damageDealt:0};beam.cast(player,angle,multiplier,getAngle);
  }
  /** Substep beam ticks and residue timers on simulation time, so pausing freezes everything. */
  function update(delta,player,aim=0) {
    if(state&&(state.owner!==player||!weapon(player))){reset();return;}
    let left=Math.max(0,delta);
    while(left>1e-8) {
      const step=Math.min(left,1/60);left-=step;
      if(state){state.elapsed+=step;if(state.elapsed>=settings.buffSeconds)removeBuff();beam.update(step,player,aim);}
      for(const residue of residues) {
        residue.age+=step;
        if(!residue.exploded&&residue.age>=settings.residueSeconds) {
          residue.exploded=true;
          for(const enemy of getAllEnemies()) {
            const body=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy);
            if(Math.hypot(body.x-residue.x,body.y-residue.y)<=settings.residueRadius+Math.max(body.rx,body.ry))
              damageEnemy(enemy.id,residue.damage,residue.owner,'normal');
          }
        }
      }
      residues=residues.filter(r=>r.age<settings.residueSeconds+.4);
      if(state&&state.elapsed>=settings.buffSeconds&&!residues.length){removeBuff();state=null;beam.reset();}
    }
  }
  function draw(context,camera) {
    beam.draw(context,camera);
    if(state&&state.elapsed<settings.buffSeconds) {
      const p=state.owner,size=p.spriteSize||89.6;
      context.save();context.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
      for(let i=0;i<16;i++) {
        const t=(state.elapsed/1.8+i*.618)%1,x=p.x-camera.x+Math.sin(i*2.4)*size*.4,y=p.y-camera.y+size*.4-t*size;

        context.beginPath();context.arc(x,y,2*(1-t*.5),0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();

    attackModifier: damageMod // Attack-specific effects, including EX drawing accuracy.

    critical, type: critical ? 'critical' : 'normal' };
}

/** Build weapon damage with independent level bonuses and optional purchased Growth.
 * mainWeaponId can explicitly identify a character main weapon; Plana defaults to her umbrella.
 */
export function totalWeaponDamage(character, weaponId, base, bonusesPercent = [], options = {}) {
  const mainWeaponId = character.mainWeaponId ?? (character.label === 'Plana' ? 'plana-umbrella' : null);
  const weapon=character.attackSlots?.find(item=>item?.id===weaponId);
  return weaponDamageFormula(base, bonusesPercent, {
    ...options, enhancementRank:weapon?.enhancementRank ?? 0, growthEligible: weaponId === mainWeaponId,
    growthRank: character.growthRank ?? growthSettings.defaultRank, playerLevel: character.level ?? 1
  });
}


/** Add the accumulated item/skill ATK bonus to the character's independent base ATK. */
export function totalCharacterATK(character) {
  return totalATKFormula(character.baseATK ?? attackStatSettings.baseATK,
    [Number(ensureCombatStats(character).atkPercent)]);
}


/** Add character and weapon critical damage bonuses; overrides replace only the base.
 * criticalMultiplier is an optional weapon base override (e.g. Umbrella LV7=3).
 * critDamagePercent contains accumulated bonuses, separate from critical chance.
 */
export function characterCriticalMultiplier(character, criticalMultiplier, weaponBonus = 0) {
  const base = criticalMultiplier !== undefined ? (criticalMultiplier - 1) * 100 :
    (character.baseCritMod ?? (combatBalance.criticalMultiplier - 1) * 100);
  const bonus = ensureCombatStats(character).critDamagePercent;
  return Math.max(0, 1 + totalCritModFormula(base, [bonus, weaponBonus]) / 100);
}


/** Measure character-to-target world distance at the hit, never from projectile origin. */
export function characterHaloMultiplier(character, target) {
  if (!target || ![character.x, character.y, target.x, target.y].every(Number.isFinite)) return 1;
  return haloDamageFormula(Math.hypot(target.x - character.x, target.y - character.y), character.haloLevel ?? 0);
}

above20. Do not randomize values<=2.
  const variance = base > damageRules.randomizeAbove
    ? Math.max(base * damageRules.variancePercent, damageRules.minimumVariance) : 0;
  const randomized = variance ? base - variance + random() * variance * 2 : base;
  return Math.max(0, Math.round(randomized * Math.max(0, damageMod)));
}

/** Crowd-adjusted arrivals: 8/s empty -> 5/s at40 nearby; 2/s at50 visible slots. */
export function spawnRateFormula(nearby, visible) {
  const s = playtestSpawnSettings;
  if (visible >= s.visibleLimit) return s.crowdedPerSecond;
  return Math.round(s.perSecond + (s.maxPerSecond - s.perSecond) *
    (1 - Math.min(1, nearby / s.nearbyTarget)));
}
export function weaponDamageFormula(baseWeaponDamage, bonusesPercent = [], {
  growthRank = 0, playerLevel = 1, growthEligible = false,
  projectileCount = 1, hitCooldownFrames = 60, enhancementRank = 0
} = {}) {
  const weapon = baseWeaponDamage * bonusesPercent.reduce((value, bonus) => value * (1 + bonus / 100), 1);
  const rank = Math.max(0, Math.min(growthSettings.maxRank, Math.floor(growthRank)));
  const tickMultiplier = Math.min(1, Math.max(growthSettings.minimumTickMultiplier,
    hitCooldownFrames / growthSettings.tickThresholdFrames));
  const growth = growthEligible ? growthSettings.damagePerLevelPerRank / damageRules.baseScale *
    rank * Math.max(1, playerLevel) / Math.max(1, projectileCount) * tickMultiplier : 0;
  // Enhancements add flat damage after level/enchantment bonuses, split over primary projectiles.
  const enhancement=Math.max(0,Math.floor(enhancementRank))*crafterSettings.enhancementDamagePerRank/damageRules.baseScale/Math.max(1,projectileCount);
  return weapon + growth + enhancement;
}

export function bonusDamageTakenFormula(bonuses = []) {
  return 1 + bonuses.reduce((sum, bonus) => sum + bonus, 0) / 100;
}


/** Damage Bonus sources use multipliers:1.2x and1.3x stack to1.5x. */
export function damageBonusFormula(bonuses = []) {
  return 1 + bonuses.reduce((sum, bonus) => sum + (bonus - 1), 0);
}


/** Independent target reductions multiply; values are percentage points (20 =20%). */
export function damageReductionFormula(reductions = []) {
  return reductions.reduce((multiplier, reduction) =>
    multiplier * (1 - Math.max(0, Math.min(100, reduction)) / 100), 1);
}


/** Halo item: threshold is inclusive for the far bonus; level0 means unequipped. */
export const haloSettings = { distanceThreshold: 130, closeMultiplier: 0.9,
  farMultipliers: [1.2, 1.4, 1.6] };
export function haloDamageFormula(distance, level = 0) {
  const rank = Math.max(0, Math.min(haloSettings.farMultipliers.length, Math.floor(level)));
  if (!rank) return 1;
  return distance < haloSettings.distanceThreshold ? haloSettings.closeMultiplier :
    haloSettings.farMultipliers[rank - 1];
}


/** Combine independent modifier categories; each category aggregates its own sources first. */
export function damageModifiersFormula({ criticalMultiplier = 1, bonusDamageTaken = 1,
  DB = 1, DR = 1, halo = 1, attackModifier = 1 } = {}) {
  return criticalMultiplier * bonusDamageTaken * DB * DR * halo * attackModifier;
}


/** Special-enemy stats are snapshots at spawn, using timer components, not total minutes.
 * SPD is a ratio of unmodified playerSettings.speed; callers convert it to movement units.
 * These profiles are opt-in pending enemy assignments and attack implementation.
 */
import { percentBonusFormula, attackDamageFormula, weaponDamageFormula, growthSettings, totalATKFormula, attackStatSettings, totalCritModFormula, bonusDamageTakenFormula, damageBonusFormula, damageReductionFormula, haloDamageFormula, damageModifiersFormula } from './game-config.js';
import { defaultCombatStats, combatBalance } from './game-config.js';
export { defaultCombatStats } from './game-config.js';
// Percent bonuses: zero keeps base values. CRIT is a direct chance percentage.


/** Initialize independent per-character combat stats without resetting upgrades. */
export function ensureCombatStats(character) {
  character.combatStats ??= {};
  character.combatStats.damageBonusMultipliers ??= [];
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(defaultCombatStats)) character.combatStats[key] ??= value;
  return character.combatStats;
}

/** Convert a bonus percentage to a multiplier (25% means 1.25 times base). */
export function statMultiplier(character, key) {
  const value = Number(ensureCombatStats(character)[key]);
  if (key === 'atkPercent') return totalCharacterATK(character) / 100;
  return percentBonusFormula(value);
}

/** Roll per-hit critical chance; target debuffs add percentage points before clamping. */
export function rollAttackDamage(character, totalWeaponDamage, random = Math.random,
  { damageMod = 1, forceCritical = false, targetCritBonus = 0, criticalMultiplier, weaponCritDamagePercent = 0, target } = {}) {
  const stats = ensureCombatStats(character);
  const buffs=Object.values(character.combatBuffs||{}).filter(Boolean);

  const critical = forceCritical || random() < Math.max(0, Math.min(100, stats.critPercent + bonusCrit + targetCritBonus)) / 100;
  const combinedModifier = damageModifiersFormula({
    criticalMultiplier: critical ? characterCriticalMultiplier(character, criticalMultiplier, weaponCritDamagePercent) : 1,
    bonusDamageTaken: bonusDamageTakenFormula(target?.bonusDamageTakenPercent ?? []),
    DB: damageBonusFormula([...stats.damageBonusMultipliers,...buffs.map(buff=>buff.damageBonusMultiplier).filter(Number.isFinite)]),
    DR: damageReductionFormula(target?.damageReductionPercent ?? []),
    halo: characterHaloMultiplier(character, target),
    attackModifier: damageMod // Attack-specific effects, including EX drawing accuracy.

/** Banked bonus only: no extra ATK or critical roll can exceed this component's cap. */

export function attackDamageFormula(totalWeaponDamage, totalATKPercent = 100, damageMod = 1, random = Math.random) {
  const base = damageRules.baseScale * Math.max(0, totalWeaponDamage) * Math.max(0, totalATKPercent) / 100;
  const variance = base > damageRules.randomizeAbove
    ? Math.max(base * damageRules.variancePercent, damageRules.minimumVariance) : 0;
  const randomized = variance ? base - variance + random() * variance * 2 : base;
  return Math.max(0, Math.round(randomized * Math.max(0, damageMod)));
}

  projectileCount = 1, hitCooldownFrames = 60, enhancementRank = 0
} = {}) {

  const rank = Math.max(0, Math.min(growthSettings.maxRank, Math.floor(growthRank)));

export function bonusDamageTakenFormula(bonuses = []) {
  return 1 + bonuses.reduce((sum, bonus) => sum + bonus, 0) / 100;

/** Damage Bonus sources use multipliers:1.2x and1.3x stack to1.5x. */
export function damageBonusFormula(bonuses = []) {
  return 1 + bonuses.reduce((sum, bonus) => sum + (bonus - 1), 0);

/** Independent target reductions multiply; values are percentage points (20 =20%). */
export function damageReductionFormula(reductions = []) {
  return reductions.reduce((multiplier, reduction) =>
    multiplier * (1 - Math.max(0, Math.min(100, reduction)) / 100), 1);
}


/** Halo item: threshold is inclusive for the far bonus; level0 means unequipped. */
export const haloSettings = { distanceThreshold: 130, closeMultiplier: 0.9,
  farMultipliers: [1.2, 1.4, 1.6] };
export function haloDamageFormula(distance, level = 0) {
  const rank = Math.max(0, Math.min(haloSettings.farMultipliers.length, Math.floor(level)));
  if (!rank) return 1;
  return distance < haloSettings.distanceThreshold ? haloSettings.closeMultiplier :
    haloSettings.farMultipliers[rank - 1];
}

  DB = 1, DR = 1, halo = 1, attackModifier = 1 } = {}) {
  return criticalMultiplier * bonusDamageTaken * DB * DR * halo * attackModifier;
}

SOURCE: C:\Users\beann\.codex\sessions\2026\11\02\rollout-2026-11-02T16-23-27-01a18d85-1c4b-7ee3-bcaa-39f9f31e2c4e_01a19e93-2ae1-7882-8237-eef4ba494e15.jsonl:5724
These are the **currently implemented** formulas.

Let:

- `A` = total ATK percentage; `100` means base ATK.
- `E` = synergy enhancement rank.
- `D` = actual damage dealt during this EX’s buff, excluding overkill.
- `F` = drawing accuracy multiplier: **1.2–2×**, typically **1.5×**.

**1. Amplifier buff — 25 seconds**

```text
Damage Bonus = existing Damage Bonus + 0.51
Crit Chance = clamp(existing Crit Chance + 22.3%, 0%, 100%)
```

With no other Damage Bonus, this gives **1.51× damage**.

**2. Shared damage calculation**

For a base damage value `B`:

```text
Variance = B > 2 ? max(B × 0.1, 2) : 0
Randomized Damage = B − Variance + random(0, 2 × Variance)

Damage = round(Randomized Damage × damageMod)
```

```text
damageMod =
    Crit Multiplier
  × Damage Bonus
  × Bonus Damage Taken
  × Damage Reduction
  × Halo Multiplier
  × Drawing Multiplier
```

Normal hits use a **1×** Crit Multiplier. Critical hits normally use **1.5×**, plus applicable critical-damage bonuses.

**3. EX laser damage**

The laser uses Supernova’s **300% weapon damage**:

```text
Laser Base Damage = 10 × (3 + 0.2 × E) × A / 100

Laser Hit Damage =
    SharedDamage(Laser Base Damage, drawing multiplier F)
  + Stored Charge
```

It hits each enemy every **0.6 seconds**, giving up to **5 hits during its 3-second firing period**.

**4. Stored-charge amplification**

```text
Player Base Attack = 10 × A / 100

Stored Charge = min(
    round(D × 0.10),
    floor(Player Base Attack × 50)
)
```

At **100% ATK**, the charge caps at **500 damage**.

For example, after dealing `2,000` actual damage:

```text
Stored Charge = min(200, 500) = 200
```

That adds **200 flat damage to each subsequent laser hit**. This added portion is applied after the normal damage calculation; it does not receive another crit, drawing, or damage multiplier.

The bank includes damage from **all your attacks during the buff**, including the laser, bullets, and residue explosions.

**5. Blue EX bullets**

```text
Bullet Base Damage = 10 × (0.5 + 0.05 × E) × A / 100

Bullet Damage = SharedDamage(Bullet Base Damage, drawing multiplier 1)
```

Each bullet rolls its own crit. Enhancement damage is divided across the weapon’s four-projectile count.

| Property | Current value |
|---|---:|
| Fire rate | 60 bullets/second |
| Blue spray duration | 3.5 seconds |
| Spread | 52.728° |
| Pierce | Unlimited |
| Same-target hit cooldown per bullet | 0.25 seconds |

Blue bullets **do not receive the laser’s added Stored Charge**.

**6. Residue explosions**

Each enemy hit by the laser leaves one stationary residue per cast.

```text
Residue Damage = highest Stored Charge recorded
                 when that enemy was hit by the laser
```

After **4 seconds from its first hit**:

```text
Explosion Damage per enemy = Residue Damage
Explosion Radius = 240 pixels
```

Further laser hits can increase its damage, but do not restart its timer. Explosions cannot crit and do not apply the damage multipliers again. Overlapping residue explosions can each damage the same enemy.

import { font21Metrics } from './font21-metrics.js';
import { font2Metrics } from './font2-metrics.js';
import { thinFontMetrics } from './font-thin-metrics.js';
import { fontMetrics } from './font-metrics.js';

/** Return tight glyph bounds so only the dark outlines meet between letters. */
export function glyphRectangle(character) {
  return fontMetrics[character] || fontMetrics['?'];
}

/** Render crisp HUD text from the supplied font sheet, refreshing only on changes. */
export function createBitmapText(canvas, { scale = 2, outlineOverlap = 1, spaceWidth = 3, fitWidth = null, variant = 'regular', maxWidth = null, wrap = true } = {}) {
  const image = new Image();
  let loaded = false;
  let text = '';
  const sourceScale = variant === 'font21' ? .25 : 1;
  const lineHeight = variant === 'font21' ? 24 : 20;
  const glyphFor = character => variant === 'font21' ? font21Metrics[character] || font21Metrics['?'] : variant === 'font2' ? font2Metrics[character] || font2Metrics['?'] : variant === 'thin' ? thinFontMetrics[character] || thinFontMetrics['?'] : glyphRectangle(character);

  function render() {
    // EDIT scale/outlineOverlap via options: 2x glyphs, one source outline pixel overlap.
    const lines = [''];
    const measure = value => [...value].reduce((sum, c) => sum + (c === ' ' ? spaceWidth : glyphFor(c).width * sourceScale - outlineOverlap), outlineOverlap) * scale;
    for (const word of text.split(' ')) {
      const index = lines.length - 1;
      const next = lines[index] ? `${lines[index]} ${word}` : word;
      if (wrap && maxWidth && lines[index] && measure(next) > maxWidth) lines.push(word);
      else lines[index] = next;
    }
    canvas.width = Math.max(1, ...lines.map(measure));
    canvas.height = lineHeight * scale * lines.length;
    canvas.style.width = fitWidth || `${canvas.width}px`;
    canvas.style.height = fitWidth ? 'auto' : `${canvas.height}px`;
    canvas.setAttribute('aria-label', text);
    if (!loaded) return;
    const context = canvas.getContext('2d');
    context.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
    lines.forEach((line, row) => {
      let x = 0;
      for (const character of line) {
        if (character !== ' ') {
          const glyph = glyphFor(character);
          context.drawImage(image, glyph.x, glyph.y, glyph.width, glyph.height,
            x * scale, (row * lineHeight + glyph.offsetY * sourceScale) * scale, glyph.width * sourceScale * scale, glyph.height * sourceScale * scale);
        }
        x += character === ' ' ? spaceWidth : glyphFor(character).width * sourceScale - outlineOverlap;
      }
    });
  }

  image.onload = () => { loaded = true; render(); };
  image.src = new URL(variant === 'font21' ? '../sprites/font2.1.png' : variant === 'font2' ? '../sprites/font2.png' : variant === 'thin' ? '../sprites/font-thin.png' : '../sprites/font.png', import.meta.url).href;
  return {
    setMaxWidth(value) { maxWidth = value; render(); },
    setText(value) {
      if (text === value) return;
      text = value;
      render();
    }
  };
}

const cache=new WeakMap();
const animationCache=new WeakMap();

/** Average every aligned pose once, then share one stable oval across the animation set. */
export function animationSpriteHurtbox(character,getFrameRectangle,padding=8) {
  const identity=character.animationFrames||character.image;
  let sizes=animationCache.get(identity);if(!sizes){sizes=new Map();animationCache.set(identity,sizes);}
  const size=character.spriteSize||89.6,key=`${size}:${character.referenceSize||215}`;
  if(sizes.has(key))return sizes.get(key);
  const scale=(size-padding*2)/(character.referenceSize||215),poses=[];
  if(character.animationFrames) {
    const clips=[character.animationFrames,...Object.values(character.actionAnimations||{})];
    for(const frames of clips)for(const frame of frames) {
      const image=frame.image;
      poses.push({image,crop:{x:0,y:0,width:image.naturalWidth,height:image.naturalHeight,footY:image.naturalHeight}});
    }
  } else {
    for(const direction of Object.keys(character.rows||{}))for(let frame=0;frame<character.layout.columnEdges.length-1;frame++) {
      poses.push({image:character.image,crop:getFrameRectangle({...character,attack:null,moving:true,direction,facing:direction},frame)});
    }
    for(const name of Object.keys(character.attacks||{}))for(const facing of Object.keys(character.attacks[name].rows))
      for(let frame=0;frame<character.layout.columnEdges.length-1;frame++)
        poses.push({image:character.image,crop:getFrameRectangle({...character,attack:{name,facing}},frame)});
  }
  if(!poses.length)return null;
  for(const pose of poses) {
    const c=pose.crop;pose.width=c.width*scale;pose.height=c.height*scale;
    pose.x=c.anchorX===undefined?-pose.width/2:-(c.anchorX-c.x)*scale;
    pose.y=size/2-padding-(c.footY-c.y)*scale;
  }
  const left=Math.min(...poses.map(p=>p.x)),top=Math.min(...poses.map(p=>p.y));
  const width=Math.max(...poses.map(p=>p.x+p.width))-left,height=Math.max(...poses.map(p=>p.y+p.height))-top;
  const canvas=document.createElement('canvas');canvas.width=canvas.height=32;
  const context=canvas.getContext('2d',{willReadFrequently:true});
  // Add equal alpha contributions instead of source-over, so every pose has equal weight.
  context.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';context.globalAlpha=1/poses.length;
  for(const p of poses)context.drawImage(p.image,p.crop.x,p.crop.y,p.crop.width,p.crop.height,
    (p.x-left)/width*32,(p.y-top)/height*32,p.width/width*32,p.height/height*32);
  const mask=spriteDamageMask(canvas,{x:0,y:0,width:32,height:32});
  const result={offsetX:left+width/2,offsetY:top+height/2+(character.bossVisualOffsetY||0),width,height,mask};
  sizes.set(key,result);return result;
}

/** Banked bonus only: no extra ATK or critical roll can exceed this component's cap. */
export function luminousNovaFinisherDamage(damageDealt,player) {
  const baseAttack=damageRules.baseScale*totalCharacterATK(player)/100;
  return Math.max(0,Math.min(Math.round(damageDealt*skill.damageFraction),Math.floor(baseAttack*skill.attackCapMultiplier)));
}

/** Nominal281% ATK before the normal damage roll; the banked extra is calculated separately. */

import { knockbackSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { getCombatHitbox, segmentHitsBody } from './combat-hitboxes.js';

/** Age resistance in gameplay seconds, retaining any configured base resistance. */
export function updateKnockbackResistance(enemy, delta) {
  if (enemy.knockbackIdleSeconds === undefined) return;
  enemy.knockbackIdleSeconds += Math.max(0, delta);
  if (enemy.knockbackIdleSeconds >= knockbackSettings.resetSeconds - 1e-8) enemy.knockbackResistanceBonus = 0;
  enemy.knockbackResistance = Math.min(knockbackSettings.maxResistance,
    Math.max(0, enemy.baseKnockbackResistance || 0) + (enemy.knockbackResistanceBonus || 0));
}

import { beginKnockback, advanceKnockback } from './knockback.js';

/** Stun independently of displacement, respecting knockback resistance and absolute immunity. */
export function applySkillControl(enemy, dx, dy, stunSeconds, travelSeconds, options = {}) {
  enemy.stunRemaining = Math.max(enemy.stunRemaining || 0, stunSeconds);
  enemy.skillKnockback = beginKnockback(enemy, dx, dy, travelSeconds, options);
  enemy.contactReaction = null; enemy.attack = null; enemy.moving = false;
}

/** Resolve stun before AI/contact so a stunned enemy cannot move or damage the player. */
export function updateEnemyControl(enemy, delta, move) {
  const stunned = enemy.stunRemaining > 0;
  if (!stunned && !enemy.skillKnockback) return false;
  enemy.stunRemaining = Math.max(0, (enemy.stunRemaining || 0) - delta);
  if (enemy.stunRemaining < 1e-6) enemy.stunRemaining = 0;
  const knockback = enemy.skillKnockback;
  if (knockback) {
    if (!advanceKnockback(enemy, knockback, delta, move)) delete enemy.skillKnockback;
  }
  if (stunned) enemy.moving = false;
  return stunned;
}

    arisAttack?.update(delta, activeCharacter, aimAngle);

/** Add or update an enemy's state without tying its lifetime to camera visibility. */
export function rememberEnemy(id, state) {
  const existed = enemies.has(id);
  const enemy = { ...enemies.get(id), ...state, id };
  const saved = savedEnemyHealth.get(enemies.get(id));
  if (saved) savedEnemyHealth.set(enemy, saved);
  applyEnemyHealthTest(enemy);
  enemies.set(id, enemy);
  if (!existed) for (const listener of spawnListeners) listener(enemy);
  return enemy;
}

/** Stagger four independently critting rounds across each three-frame cycle; ignore Haste. */
export function createPrincessKeyAttack({random=Math.random}={}) {
  let bullets=[],owner=null,cooldown=0,enabled=true,shots=0,gaps=[],shotIndex=0,exMode='normal';
  function reset(){bullets=[];owner=null;cooldown=0;shots=0;gaps=[];shotIndex=0;}
  function update(delta,player,aim=0,viewport=null) {
    if(!player.attackSlots?.some(w=>w?.id==='princess-key')){reset();return;}
    if(owner!==player){reset();owner=player;}
    if((!enabled&&exMode==='normal')||delta<=0)return;
    const body=getCombatHitbox(player,false);
    const view=viewport||{x:body.x-640,y:body.y-360,width:1280,height:720};
    let remaining=delta;
    while(remaining>1e-8) {
      if(cooldown<=1e-8) {
        const body=getCombatHitbox(player,false);
        if(shotIndex===0) {
          // Positive randomized gaps sum to exactly one base cycle, preserving total fire rate.
          const weights=Array.from({length:settings.attackCount},()=>.7+random()*.6);
          const total=weights.reduce((sum,value)=>sum+value,0);
          gaps=weights.map(value=>settings.interval*value/total/(exMode==='beam' ? settings.exFireRateMultiplier : 1));
        }
        {
          const angle=aim+(random()-.5)*settings.spreadRadians*(exMode==='beam'?settings.exSpreadMultiplier:1);
          const dx=Math.cos(angle),dy=Math.sin(angle);
          const offset=1/Math.hypot(dx/body.rx,dy/body.ry)+3+settings.diameter*1.8;
          bullets.push({x:body.x+dx*offset,y:body.y+dy*offset,angle,color:exMode==='beam'?'blue':'pink',
            pierceLimit:exMode==='beam'?Infinity:settings.hitLimit,speed:settings.speed,age:0,hits:new Map(),hitCount:0});shots++;
        }
        cooldown=gaps[shotIndex];shotIndex=(shotIndex+1)%settings.attackCount;
      }
      const step=Math.min(remaining,cooldown,1/60),enemies=getAllEnemies();
      for(let i=bullets.length-1;i>=0;i--) {
        const bullet=bullets[i],from={x:bullet.x,y:bullet.y},dt=step;
        bullet.age+=dt;bullet.x+=Math.cos(bullet.angle)*settings.speed*dt;bullet.y+=Math.sin(bullet.angle)*settings.speed*dt;
        for(const enemy of enemies) {
          if(bullet.hitCount>=bullet.pierceLimit)break;
          if(bullet.age-(bullet.hits.get(enemy.id)??-Infinity)<settings.hitCooldown||!luminousNovaHits(enemy,from,bullet,settings.diameter*1.8))continue;
          bullet.hits.set(enemy.id,bullet.age);bullet.hitCount++;
          const hit=rollAttackDamage(player,totalWeaponDamage(player,'princess-key',settings.damageMultiplier,[],{projectileCount:4,hitCooldownFrames:15}),random,{target:enemy});
          const landed=damageEnemy(enemy.id,hit.damage,player,hit.type,{canMiss:true,damageGroup:'princess-key'}),living=getEnemy(enemy.id);
          if(landed!==false&&living)applySkillControl(living,Math.cos(bullet.angle)*settings.knockbackSpeed*settings.knockbackSeconds,
            Math.sin(bullet.angle)*settings.knockbackSpeed*settings.knockbackSeconds,settings.knockbackSeconds,settings.knockbackSeconds);
        }
        if(princessBulletOffscreen(bullet,view)||bullet.hitCount>=bullet.pierceLimit)bullets.splice(i,1);
      }
      remaining-=step;cooldown=Math.max(0,cooldown-step);
    }
  }
  return {ready:Promise.resolve(),reset,update,
    setExMode(active,shooting) {
      const next=active&&shooting?'beam':'normal';
      if(next===exMode)return;

/** Despawn only after the complete head bloom and continuous tail clear the current camera. */
export function princessBulletOffscreen(bullet,view) {
  const radius=settings.diameter/2,padding=radius*luminousNovaSettings.bloomRadiusScale;
  const length=Math.min(radius*(1+luminousNovaSettings.trailLengthRatio),settings.speed*bullet.age);
  const tailX=bullet.x-Math.cos(bullet.angle)*length,tailY=bullet.y-Math.sin(bullet.angle)*length;
  return Math.max(bullet.x,tailX)+padding<view.x||Math.min(bullet.x,tailX)-padding>view.x+view.width||
    Math.max(bullet.y,tailY)+padding<view.y||Math.min(bullet.y,tailY)-padding>view.y+view.height;
}

/** Fire-rate bonuses are absolute multiples of the base cycle, never cumulative multipliers. */
export function luminousNovaLevelStats(player) {
  const level=Math.max(1,Math.min(7,getLuminousNova(player)?.level||1));
  const fireRate=1+Number(level>=3)+Number(level>=5)+Number(level>=7);
  return {level,fireRate,interval:luminousNovaSettings.attackInterval/fireRate,
    damageMultiplier:(level>=2?1.2:1)*(level>=4?1.3:1),knockback:level>=6};
}

/** Damage levels multiply base damage; flat enhancements split over the base-cycle projectile count. */
export function rollLuminousNovaDamage(player,random=Math.random,target) {

  return rollAttackDamage(player,totalWeaponDamage(player,'luminous-nova',luminousNovaSettings.damageMultiplier,
    [(stats.damageMultiplier-1)*100],{projectileCount:stats.fireRate,hitCooldownFrames:10}),random,{target});
}

/** Independent aimed, unlimited-piercing automatic plasma weapon. */
export function createLuminousNovaAttack({random=Math.random}={}) {
  const s=luminousNovaSettings;
  let owner=null,cooldown=0,bullets=[],enabled=true,shots=0,skillFinishing=false;
  function reset(){owner=null;cooldown=0;bullets=[];shots=0;}
  function fire(player,aim) {
    const origin=getCombatHitbox(player,false);
    // Follow the shared arrow/crosshair aim and keep that direction throughout this shot.
    const angle=Number.isFinite(aim)?aim:0;
    const dx=Math.cos(angle),dy=Math.sin(angle);
    const edge=1/Math.hypot(dx/origin.rx,dy/origin.ry);
    const offset=edge+s.muzzleGap+s.bulletDiameter/2*s.bloomRadiusScale;
    if(bullets.length<s.maxProjectiles){bullets.push({x:origin.x+dx*offset,y:origin.y+dy*offset,angle,age:0,travel:0,accelerating:true,hits:new Map()});shots++;}
    return true;
  }
  /** Move and expire each shot independently; pierce all targets with a per-shot hit cooldown. */
  function advance(delta,player) {
    for(let i=bullets.length-1;i>=0;i--) {
      const bullet=bullets[i],step=Math.min(delta,s.duration-bullet.age),from={x:bullet.x,y:bullet.y};
      // Integrate the speed ramp analytically so acceleration is independent of frame rate.
      const distanceAt=age=>s.projectileSpeed*(age<s.accelerationSeconds?age*age/(2*s.accelerationSeconds):age-s.accelerationSeconds/2);
      const distance=distanceAt(bullet.age+step)-distanceAt(bullet.age);
      bullet.age+=step;bullet.travel+=distance;
      bullet.x+=Math.cos(bullet.angle)*distance;bullet.y+=Math.sin(bullet.angle)*distance;
      for(const enemy of getAllEnemies()) {
        if(bullet.age-(bullet.hits.get(enemy.id)??-Infinity)<s.hitCooldown-1e-8||!luminousNovaHits(enemy,from,bullet))continue;
        bullet.hits.set(enemy.id,bullet.age); // A missed hit cannot retry every frame.
        const hit=rollLuminousNovaDamage(player,random,enemy);
        const landed=damageEnemy(enemy.id,hit.damage,player,hit.type,{canMiss:true});
        const living=getEnemy(enemy.id);
        if(landed!==false&&living&&luminousNovaLevelStats(player).knockback) {
          const distance=s.knockbackSpeed*s.knockbackSeconds;
          applySkillControl(living,Math.cos(bullet.angle)*distance,Math.sin(bullet.angle)*distance,
            s.knockbackSeconds,s.knockbackSeconds);
        }
      }
      if(bullet.age>=s.duration-1e-8)bullets.splice(i,1);
    }
  }
  /** Stagger shots over the2.5s base cycle; Haste changes cadence, not lifetime or hit cooldown. */
  function update(delta,player,aim=0) {
    if(!getLuminousNova(player)){reset();return;}
    if(owner!==player){reset();owner=player;}
    if(!enabled||delta<=0)return;
    if(skillFinishing){advance(delta,player);return;}
    let remaining=delta;
    while(remaining>1e-8) {
      if(cooldown<=1e-8) {
        fire(player,aim);
        cooldown=attackTimeFormula(luminousNovaLevelStats(player).interval,ensureCombatStats(player).hastePercent);

// EDIT half-width, half-height and center offset as fractions of display size.
// Ellipses exclude transparent corners while covering more of the visible body.
export const combatHitboxes = {
  plana: { rx: 0.27, ry: 0.38, y: 0.03, playerOffsetY: 6, playerRadiusScale: 0.72 }, // Pixels downward for the controlled player.
  arona: { rx: 0.25, ry: 0.39, y: 0.03 },
  // Small foot-level ellipse: tune rx/ry for size; feet keeps it at the sprite baseline.
  midori: { rx: 0.13, ry: 0.075, radiusSize: normalSpriteSize, feet: true },
  yuuka: { rx: 0.25, ry: 0.42, y: 0.02 },
  mob: { rx: 0.28, ry: 0.28, y: 0.04, eliteOffsetY: 6, normalOffsetY: 6 }, // Circular Mob collider; elite variants scale the same profile.
  iroha: { rx: 0.44, ry: 0.29, y: 0.06 },
  shiroko: { rx: 0.30, ry: 0.30, y: 0.05 } // Center on the visible body below the halo.
};

/** Return a stable body ellipse, scaling automatically for elite/boss sizes. */
export function getCombatHitbox(character, enemy = Boolean(character.id)) {
  const name = (character.type || character.label || 'mob').toLowerCase();
  const key = Object.keys(combatHitboxes).find(type => name.includes(type)) || 'mob';
  const profile = character.combatHitbox || combatHitboxes[key];
  const size = character.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize;
  const hitboxScale = enemy ? combatBalance.enemyHitboxScale : 1;
  const radiusSize = profile.radiusSize || size;
  const rx = radiusSize * profile.rx * hitboxScale * (enemy ? 1 : profile.playerRadiusScale || 1);
  // Compress player height to the existing half-width, producing a centered circle.
  const ry = enemy ? radiusSize * profile.ry * hitboxScale : rx;
  // Foot-anchored profiles retain their small dimensions when the artwork grows.
  const offsetY = !enemy ? (profile.playerOffsetY || 0) : profile.feet ? size / 2 - spriteDisplayPadding - ry : size * profile.y;
  const eliteOffsetY = enemy ? (character.elite ? profile.eliteOffsetY || 0 : profile.normalOffsetY || 0) : 0;
  return { x: character.x, y: character.y + offsetY + eliteOffsetY, rx, ry };
}

/** Damage-receiving sprite bounds are separate from the small contact-damage ellipse. */
export function getEnemyHurtbox(character) {

    y:character.y+bounds.offsetY+(oval.y-.5)*bounds.height,
    rx:oval.rx*bounds.width,ry:oval.ry*bounds.height,shape:'ellipse',
    coverage:oval.coverage,emptyFraction:oval.emptyFraction,meetsTargets:oval.meetsTargets};
  return {x:character.x+bounds.offsetX,y:character.y+bounds.offsetY,
    rx:Math.max(1,bounds.width/2),ry:Math.max(1,bounds.height/2),shape:'rectangle',
    mask:bounds.mask,mirrored:bounds.mirrored,maskWidth:bounds.width,maskHeight:bounds.height};
}

/** Test a segment against sprite rectangles or the existing contact ellipses. */
export function segmentHitsBody(body, x1, y1, x2, y2) {
  if(body.shape==='rectangle') {
    let near=0,far=1;
    for(const [start,end,center,radius] of [[x1,x2,body.x,body.rx],[y1,y2,body.y,body.ry]]) {
      const delta=end-start;
      if(Math.abs(delta)<1e-10){if(start<center-radius||start>center+radius)return false;continue;}
      let a=(center-radius-start)/delta,b=(center+radius-start)/delta;
      if(a>b)[a,b]=[b,a];near=Math.max(near,a);far=Math.min(far,b);
      if(near>far)return false;
    }
    if(!body.mask)return true;
    // The broad crop rectangle overlaps; now require actual opaque sprite pixels.
    const padX=Math.max(0,body.rx-body.maskWidth/2),padY=Math.max(0,body.ry-body.maskHeight/2);
    return body.mask.some(run=>segmentHitsBody({shape:'rectangle',
      x:body.x+(run.x-.5)*body.maskWidth*(body.mirrored?-1:1),
      y:body.y+(run.y-.5)*body.maskHeight,
      rx:run.width*body.maskWidth/2+padX,ry:run.height*body.maskHeight/2+padY},x1,y1,x2,y2));
  }
  const x = (x1 - body.x) / body.rx, y = (y1 - body.y) / body.ry;
  const dx = (x2 - x1) / body.rx, dy = (y2 - y1) / body.ry;
  const length = dx * dx + dy * dy;
  const t = length ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1, -(x * dx + y * dy) / length)) : 0;
  return (x + dx * t) ** 2 + (y + dy * t) ** 2 <= 1;
}

/** Boss identity is explicit, never inferred from an elite's enlarged sprite. */
export function isBossEnemy(enemy) {
  if(enemy.boss === false) return false;
  return enemy.boss === true || enemy.type === 'iroha' || enemy.type === 'shiroko';
}

/** Render special enemies above normal actors, while bosses always own the final layer. */
export function enemyRenderLayer(enemy) {
  if (isBossEnemy(enemy)) return 'boss';
  return enemy.special === true || enemy.type === 'yuuka' ? 'special' : 'normal';
}

/** Measure distance from sprite edges to the gameplay viewport rectangle. */
export function enemyViewportDistance(enemy, camera, width, height) {
  const radius = (enemy.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) / 2;
  const dx = Math.max(camera.x - (enemy.x + radius), enemy.x - radius - camera.x - width, 0);
  const dy = Math.max(camera.y - (enemy.y + radius), enemy.y - radius - camera.y - height, 0);
  return Math.hypot(dx, dy);
}

const enemies = new Map();
const spawnListeners = new Set();
const defeatListeners = new Set();
const damageListeners = new Set();
let killCount = 0;

export const enemyTestConfig = { oneHp: isAdminSeed };
const savedEnemyHealth = new WeakMap();

/** Toggle 1-HP enemies for this session, including elites, bosses and future spawns. */
export function setOneHpEnemies(enabled) {
  enemyTestConfig.oneHp = Boolean(enabled);
  for (const enemy of enemies.values()) applyEnemyHealthTest(enemy);
}

/** Preserve normal health so disabling the test restores surviving enemies. */
function applyEnemyHealthTest(enemy) {
  if (enemyTestConfig.oneHp) {
    if (!savedEnemyHealth.has(enemy)) savedEnemyHealth.set(enemy, { hp: enemy.hp, maxHp: enemy.maxHp });
    enemy.hp = enemy.maxHp = 1;
  } else if (savedEnemyHealth.has(enemy)) {
    Object.assign(enemy, savedEnemyHealth.get(enemy));
    savedEnemyHealth.delete(enemy);
  }
}

/** Observe real spawns/defeats; cleanup removals never emit these events. */
export function onEnemySpawn(listener) {
  spawnListeners.add(listener);
  return () => spawnListeners.delete(listener);
}
export function onEnemyDefeat(listener) {
  defeatListeners.add(listener);
  return () => defeatListeners.delete(listener);
}

/** Count confirmed defeats for this session; admin removal does not count. */
export function getKillCount() {
  return killCount;
}

/** Return all session records, including enemies outside the camera view. */
export function getAllEnemies() {
  return [...enemies.values()];
}

/** Observe accepted HP damage, excluding misses, overkill and forced harmless-enemy removal. */
export function onEnemyDamage(listener) {
  damageListeners.add(listener);return ()=>damageListeners.delete(listener);
}

import { beginKnockback, advanceKnockback } from './knockback.js';

/** Stun independently of displacement, respecting knockback resistance and absolute immunity. */
export function applySkillControl(enemy, dx, dy, stunSeconds, travelSeconds, options = {}) {
  enemy.stunRemaining = Math.max(enemy.stunRemaining || 0, stunSeconds);
  enemy.skillKnockback = beginKnockback(enemy, dx, dy, travelSeconds, options);
  enemy.contactReaction = null; enemy.attack = null; enemy.moving = false;
}

/** Resolve stun before AI/contact so a stunned enemy cannot move or damage the player. */
export function updateEnemyControl(enemy, delta, move) {
  const stunned = enemy.stunRemaining > 0;
  if (!stunned && !enemy.skillKnockback) return false;
  enemy.stunRemaining = Math.max(0, (enemy.stunRemaining || 0) - delta);
  if (enemy.stunRemaining < 1e-6) enemy.stunRemaining = 0;
  const knockback = enemy.skillKnockback;
  if (knockback) {
    if (!advanceKnockback(enemy, knockback, delta, move)) delete enemy.skillKnockback;
  }
  if (stunned) enemy.moving = false;
  return stunned;
}
